title: Experienced Developer
description:
IMPORTANT: We are NOT hiring beginners OR FREELANCERS. This is not an entry-level or learning role. You need 5+ years of professional web development experience and live projects in both Webflow and Shopify. If that isn’t you, please do not apply. WE'RE LOOKING FOR A FULL TIME HIRE.



Pay: $8–$10 per hour, depending on experience



About Us

PM Furniture Assembly is a U.S.-based installation company serving homeowners and major product brands across the country. We install saunas, pergolas, gazebos, sheds, playsets and similar products. We’re rebuilding our website to support hundreds of product, brand and city pages, and we need a strong developer to lead the build.



The Project

Our website runs on Webflow today, and an agency will migrate it to Shopify. Once it’s live, we need someone to build out and maintain a very large library of pages and to make sure it’s all structured to scale.



We don’t have web development expertise in-house, and that’s why we’re hiring you. We’ll bring the business goals and the content. You make the decisions about how it’s built: architecture, templates, CMS structure, SEO and page performance. We also want your opinion when you see a better way.



What You’ll Do



Own page building and structure across Webflow now and Shopify after the migration

Design reusable templates and CMS structures that make adding hundreds of pages fast and consistent

Build pages from scratch with strong design and conversion sense

Review the agency’s work on the new Shopify site and flag problems

Build SEO and AI search optimization into every page from the start

Keep the site fast, mobile-first and clean



What We’re Looking For



5+ years of web development experience, with deep, proven experience in both Webflow and Shopify. You’re an expert in both, not someone who has touched one.

Strong HTML, CSS and some JavaScript

Webflow CMS and reusable components, with a clean class naming approach (Client-First or similar)

Shopify Liquid, sections and theme customization

Strong design sense and understanding of conversion-focused layouts

You take ownership and make decisions without being told what to do

Clear written and spoken English

Reliable internet and a computer



Nice to Have



SEO and AEO (AI search) experience, including structured data

Product configurators, custom forms or quote flows

Webflow-to-Shopify migration experience

GitHub or version control



Schedule



Full-time, 8 hours a day, Monday to Friday

9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time

Open to suggested schedule





How to Apply

Please read carefully. Applications that don’t follow these steps won’t be considered.



Start your message with the word “Pergola”

Before recording your video, visit our website: 

Include a 2-minute video (Loom, YouTube unlisted, or Google Drive link). In it, tell us:

what you took from reading this job description and how you think you could help us

something about our website that caught your attention

Please don’t spend the video on your own background. We’ll see that in your work.

Share 3 live sites or pages you built, including at least one in Webflow and one in Shopify, and what you personally built

Describe one custom feature or Shopify section you built and how you approached it

Tell us your years of experience with Webflow and with Shopify



Tell us your expected hourly rate within the range above



Our Hiring Process

We’ll review every application and video, and then reach out to the candidates we’d like to move forward with. Those candidates will be asked to do a paid trial: building a product page for us in Webflow. The page will include product options and add-ons, and we’ll look closely at your SEO and AI search optimization. You’ll be paid for your time on the trial.

If you have a genuine "growth mindset," can take a single instruction and run with it independently, and want a long-term career with massive growth potential—this is for you.



The author of this project operates completely behind the scenes (anonymous), and you will be our digital driving force, managing strategic outreach, building social communities, and connecting with global partners.

- Exceptional English (written and verbal).

- High autonomy – you must be a problem-solver who knows how to leverage advanced AI tools, not just a task follower.

How to Apply (Strict Screening Process):

title: Experienced Meta Ads Campaign Launcher / Campaign Manager (E-Commerce)
description:
Our growing e-commerce company is hiring! We are looking for a highly experienced Meta Ads Campaign Launcher to join our team long-term.



We need someone who has extensive experience launching
 and Instagram advertising campaigns, understands e-commerce marketing, and has an exceptional eye for detail.



This is NOT a beginner or trainee position. We are not looking to teach someone how to launch campaigns. We want an expert who already knows exactly what they are doing, can work independently, and takes full responsibility for ensuring every campaign is launched correctly.



What Does a Campaign Launcher Do?



You will be responsible for setting up, reviewing, and launching advertising campaigns across our Meta ad accounts.



You will receive creatives, ad copy, product information, and landing pages. Your responsibility is to ensure everything is implemented correctly, optimised, and thoroughly checked before going live.



We work in a fast-paced e-commerce environment, regularly testing new products, advertising angles, and creatives.



Attention to detail is absolutely essential. We frequently adapt competitor advertising concepts, so you must ensure that no competitor brand names, incorrect product information, old URLs, pricing, or irrelevant copy are ever left behind.



We want someone who can spot mistakes before they happen, rather than relying on us to find them afterwards.



Responsibilities and Duties



Creating, setting up, and launching Meta 
 and Instagram) advertising campaigns.



Correctly setting up campaigns, ad sets, budgets, targeting, placements, and advertisements.



Uploading and organising static images, videos, headlines, primary text, and descriptions.



Thoroughly proofreading all ad copy before launching.



Ensuring no competitor brand names, product references, incorrect offers, or leftover competitor information remain.



Checking that every advertisement links to the correct landing page or product page.



Ensuring all prices, currencies, languages, and promotional offers are correct for the target market.



Checking that creatives, copy, headlines, and landing pages all match.



Verifying tracking configurations and campaign settings are correct.



Performing thorough quality checks before and after launching campaigns.



Identifying potential mistakes, inconsistencies, or improvements without needing to be told.



Keeping campaigns organised and communicating clearly with the team.



Qualifications and Skills



Highly experienced with Meta Ads Manager. You must already have strong, practical experience launching campaigns for e-commerce businesses.



Exceptional attention to detail. Nothing gets past you. Even the smallest mistake should be noticed and corrected before launch.



Independent and proactive. We don't want to micromanage or explain basic tasks. You should know your role inside out.



Marketing-oriented. You understand how e-commerce advertising works, including offers, creatives, landing pages, and conversions.



Passionate about processes and systems. You have a clear workflow and use checklists to ensure nothing is overlooked.



Technically confident. You understand Meta Ads Manager, campaign structures, tracking, and troubleshooting.



Fast but accurate. You can launch multiple campaigns efficiently without sacrificing accuracy.



Accountable and reliable. You take ownership of your work and ensure tasks are completed to a high standard.



Excellent communication skills. You communicate clearly, ask questions when necessary, and keep the team updated.



Open to feedback. Even with extensive experience, you are always looking to improve your workflow and performance.



Experience Requirements



We are specifically looking for someone who has previous experience working with e-commerce brands, ideally within direct-response marketing or dropshipping.



You must be confident managing the entire campaign launching process independently.



Experience working with multiple ad accounts, high volumes of creatives, and different international markets would be a significant advantage.



We are not looking for someone who has simply watched tutorials or completed courses. We need someone with proven, hands-on experience.



You should be able to explain your existing campaign-launching workflow and the steps you take to ensure every detail is correct before an advertisement goes live.



Salary Expectations & Working Arrangement



Competitive hourly rate depending on experience and expertise.



Fully remote position.



Looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship.



Initial paid trial period to assess your skills, accuracy, and workflow.



Opportunity for increased compensation and additional responsibilities as the company grows.



Benefits



Work with an ambitious and growing international e-commerce company.



Fully remote work.



Long-term opportunity with consistent work.



Opportunity to grow within the company.



Work alongside an experienced e-commerce team.



Performance bonuses and opportunities for increased compensation based on results and quality of work.



Our Expectations



We take quality, accountability, and attention to detail extremely seriously.



We need someone who treats every campaign as though it were their own business and understands that even a small mistake can waste advertising budget.



You should take pride in delivering work that is accurate, organised, and thoroughly checked.



We value people who think independently, constantly look for improvements, and genuinely care about producing excellent work.



If you require constant supervision, regularly overlook small details, or are still learning the fundamentals of Meta advertising, this position will not be the right fit.



However, if you're highly experienced, organised, intelligent, and confident in your abilities, we'd love to hear from you!



How to Apply



To prove you've read this entire job description, start your message with the word "BLUE".



Then please answer the following:



How many years of experience do you have launching Meta advertising campaigns, and what types of e-commerce businesses have you worked with?



Walk me through your exact workflow when launching a new campaign, from receiving the creatives and ad copy to the campaign going live.



What specific checks do you perform to ensure there are no mistakes, incorrect links, competitor references, or errors in the advertising copy?



How do you organise and manage multiple campaigns and creatives across different ad accounts?



What hourly rate are you looking for, and how many hours per week are you available?



Applications without "BLUE" and a clear explanation of your campaign-launching workflow will not be considered.



We're looking for someone who can become a valuable long-term member of our team.



We look forward to hearing from you!



Kind regards,

Chapman Ecommerce

title: E-Commerce Product Researcher – Funnel-Focused Products, Meta ads
description:
We are a fast-growing e-commerce business building and scaling direct-response brands across multiple markets.



As we expand into new countries and launch additional products, we are seeking an expert Product Researcher who understands how to identify products specifically suited to high-converting sales funnels and dedicated landing pages.



This is not a standard dropshipping product research role focused on finding products to upload directly to Shopify product pages.



We are looking for funnel-focused products that can be sold through a dedicated customer journey, typically moving from a paid social advertisement to an advertorial or listicle and then to a high-converting landing page or sales funnel.



We are willing to pay well for someone with genuine expertise who can consistently identify high-quality opportunities rather than submit large lists of random products.



### Job Responsibilities



* Research and identify high-potential products suited to sales funnels, advertorials, listicles and dedicated landing pages.

* Find products with strong direct-response potential that can be marketed around a clear problem, desire, transformation or unique angle.

* Research products that are already demonstrating demand while identifying opportunities that have not yet become completely saturated.

* Use the
 Ad Library extensively to 
 competitors, active advertisements, creative angles, advertorials, listicles, landing pages, offers and brands that are currently scaling.

* Use TrendTrack and other current product and trend research platforms to identify emerging products and opportunities.

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and other relevant platforms to expand product research, discover alternative keywords, identify product terminology, uncover customer problems, explore niche terminology and generate competitor search terms.

* Go beyond obvious product names when researching. We expect you to uncover different keywords, synonyms, problem-based searches and marketing angles that help reveal products others may miss.

* Analyse competitor funnels from the advertisement through to the advertorial or listicle, landing page, offer structure, bundles and upsells.

* Identify products with strong potential for bundling and increasing average order value.

* Prioritise shipping-friendly products, ideally smaller and lightweight items that are inexpensive and straightforward to fulfil internationally.

* Avoid products that are excessively large, fragile, extremely heavy or otherwise difficult and expensive to ship.

* Evaluate sourcing opportunities, approximate product costs, perceived value, potential selling prices and available margins.

* Research whether multiple quantities, bundles or complementary products could create stronger offers.

* Provide clear reasoning behind every product recommendation rather than simply submitting product links.

* Stay up to date with changing advertising trends, winning funnels, emerging niches, competitor strategies and new research tools.

* Communicate and collaborate effectively through Slack, which is required for day-to-day team communication and project updates.



### What We Are Looking For



We are specifically seeking an experienced e-commerce product researcher, not someone looking to learn product research from scratch.



You should have:



* Proven experience researching winning or scalable e-commerce products.

* Strong experience researching products designed to be sold through funnels, advertorials, listicles and dedicated landing pages rather than standard Shopify product pages alone.

* Expert knowledge of the
 Ad Library and the ability to conduct deep competitor research rather than basic searches.

* Experience using TrendTrack or similar modern product and advertising research platforms.

* A strong understanding of direct-response marketing and what makes a product suitable for a funnel.

* A solid understanding of product-market fit, customer pain points, emotional buying triggers and marketing angles.

* The ability to distinguish between a product that simply looks interesting and one that could realistically support a profitable advertising campaign.

* A strong understanding of bundles, quantity breaks, upsells and offer creation.

* The ability to assess shipping considerations, sourcing costs, margins and perceived product value.

* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and other relevant platforms for advanced research, including generating search terms, alternative keywords, niche terminology and research directions.

* Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.

* Fluent English and the ability to clearly explain why you believe a product has potential.

* Familiarity with Slack and the ability to use it reliably for communication, collaboration and sharing research updates.

* A proactive mindset. We do not want someone who needs to be told exactly which keywords to search or where to look.

* Please include word 'blue' in your application so we know you have read and understood the job post fully.



### Exclusivity & Confidentiality



This is extremely important to us.



We do not want someone simultaneously researching and supplying the same products or opportunities to other e-commerce businesses.



The products, competitors, funnels, niches and opportunities you discover while working with us must remain confidential.



You will be required to sign an NDA or confidentiality agreement before beginning work with us.



We are looking to build a long-term relationship with someone who becomes an important part of our product development and scaling process.



### Compensation & Growth



We are willing to pay for expertise.



We are not looking for the cheapest product researcher available. If you can consistently identify genuinely strong products and opportunities, we are happy to compensate you accordingly.



Compensation can be structured around experience, workload and results.



This is not intended to be a short-term position.



Our team is growing rapidly, and we are expanding into additional international markets. As a result, our need for product research will continue to increase.



For the right person, there is significant room to grow with the company, take on greater responsibility and become a key part of our wider product research and development operation.



### What We Value



We want someone who:



* Thinks independently.

* Understands direct-response e-commerce.

* Is naturally curious and enjoys digging deeper than competitors.

* Keeps up with the latest research tools and methods.

* Can recognise trends early.

* Understands that quality is more important than quantity.

* Can explain the reasoning and evidence behind every recommendation.

* Communicates consistently and effectively through Slack.

* Wants to work long-term with a growing e-commerce team.



### How to Apply



If you believe you are an expert e-commerce product researcher, we would like to hear from you.



Please include:



* Your previous product research experience.

* The research tools you currently use.

* Your experience with the
 Ad Library.

* Your experience with TrendTrack or similar platforms.

* How you identify products suitable for funnels, advertorials or listicles rather than standard product pages.

* Examples of products you have previously discovered that went on to perform successfully, where possible.

* How you use AI within your product research workflow.

* Your familiarity and experience with Slack.

* Your availability and preferred compensation structure.

* The word “blue” to confirm that you have read and understood this job post fully.



Please do not send a generic application.



We are looking for someone who already understands advanced product research and can demonstrate a clear process for finding products with genuine funnel and scaling potential.



If you are excellent at finding opportunities before everyone else does and want to become part of a growing e-commerce team expanding into new markets, we would love to hear from you.

title: Guest Experience & Operations VA — US Short-Term Rentals (15–40 hrs/wk, hourly, scheduled raises)
description:
ABOUT US

Travel Home LLC is a US company that runs 8 short-term rental homes in Central Texas, listed on Airbnb and Vrbo. Our remote operations desk is the heart of the business: it looks after guests, keeps cleaners and maintenance on schedule, and keeps the owner informed. We are adding to that desk.



THE ROLE

Guest Experience & Operations Virtual Assistant. Hourly pay, 15–40 hours per week depending on your availability and performance, with scheduled pay increases. Long-term role for the right person.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Answer guest messages on Airbnb and Vrbo quickly and warmly: inquiries, check-in instructions, FAQs, lockouts, date changes, early check-in / late check-out requests

- Cover our guest phone and text line during your shift

- Manage bookings and calendars: catch double bookings, wrong dates and gaps before the guest does

- Schedule turnovers and coordinate cleaners: send the next-day cleaning plan, get confirmations, check arrival and house-ready photos before a home is marked guest-ready

- Coordinate maintenance and vendors, and track each issue until it is closed

- Triage problems: solve what you can, escalate what you must (safety, access, damage, refunds) with the facts ready

- Follow up on reviews and draft review replies

- Light admin and reporting: supply and inventory logs, hours logs, a clear end-of-shift report (what happened, what is open, who owns it)



SCHEDULE

Shifts are set in US Central Time (CT). Our desk is covered 8:00 AM–10:00 PM CT, 7 days a week, so some evenings and weekends are part of the job. Tell us the CT hours you can reliably work.



WHAT YOU NEED

- Strong written AND spoken English (you will talk with US guests, cleaners and vendors)

- Reliable internet: at least 25 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload, plus a backup connection and backup power

- Your own computer and a quiet place to take calls

- Comfortable with Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, Calendar) and with using AI tools to work faster and more accurately

- Calm under pressure, careful with door codes, dates and guest information

- Preferred: short-term rental / Airbnb / Vrbo, hospitality or customer-support experience



PAY AND TERMS

- USD $2.25–$6.50 per hour, based on experience and trial results

- Hourly pay, paid weekly

- Scheduled pay increases: your rate is reviewed on a set schedule and goes up as you hit your scorecard targets

- 15–40 hours per week; hours grow with performance

- Independent contractor

- Short PAID trial before any long-term offer



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these steps are not read)

1. Make BLUEBONNET the first word of your subject line.

2. Include a link to a 60–90 second voice recording, in English, telling us about a time you solved a problem for a customer or guest.

3. Include a screenshot or link of an internet speed test taken today (speedtest.net or 
), and tell us what your backup internet and backup power are.

4. In 3–4 sentences: your STR or customer-support experience, the US Central Time hours you can work, and your expected hourly rate.



Shortlisted applicants get a short written test, a brief interview and a paid trial. We reply to every applicant who follows the steps above.

title: B2B Contact Researcher - Law Firm List Cleanup (Occasional Projects)
description:
McDougall Interactive is looking for one careful, experienced researcher to verify and update business contact lists, starting with Massachusetts law firms. Future projects may include other businesses.



This is occasional project-based work, not a full-time position. We will begin with a paid five-firm test. If the work meets the requirements, the next batch will be the remaining 20 firms in our 25-firm pilot. Additional projects may follow, but there are no guaranteed weekly hours. Work can be done on a flexible schedule with agreed deadlines.



We provide the firms, existing information and a structured spreadsheet. Your job is to verify, correct and fill gaps.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Confirm current firm names, websites, office locations and business phone numbers.

- Find the current managing partner, owner or marketing decision-maker and confirm that the person still works there.

- Find professional
 addresses supported by published sources or reputable contact-data providers. Record the source, verification tool, result and date. Clearly flag catch-all, unknown and unavailable results.

- Verify mailing addresses. Keep street, suite, city, state and ZIP in separate columns, preserving leading zeros in ZIP codes.

- Research employee estimates where available, stating whether they cover one office, Massachusetts locations or the whole company. Do not present attorney counts or public estimates as confirmed W-2 payroll counts.

- Record exact source URLs and dates checked. Flag mergers, renamed firms, departed contacts, duplicates and conflicting information.



QUALITY EXPECTATIONS

Accuracy matters more than filling every cell. Do not invent
s, names or employee counts. Leave unknown fields blank and explain what you could not confirm. Preserve the supplied record IDs and keep contacts attached to the correct firms when sorting.



Deliver in Excel or Google Sheets using our template. This is research only; do not contact the firms. We handle outreach and mailing-label production separately.



We want to work directly with the person doing the research. Please perform the work yourself; no subcontracting without prior approval. Clear
 communication is important, as we prefer to manage project updates in our inbox.



PAY AND APPLICATION

This is paid work with pricing agreed before each project. No unpaid test work. Please include:

1. Your fixed-price quote for the five-firm paid test and your hourly rate.

2. Your expected turnaround time and availability for occasional projects.

3. Your research sources and
 verification tools, and whether tool costs are included in your quote.

4. A relevant work sample with confidential information removed.

5. A brief explanation of how you verify that a contact still works at a firm and how you handle uncertain employee counts.

6. Confirmation that you will personally do the work.



Please begin your application with "Law Firm Research" so we can identify applications for this project easily. In your application, include the
 address you prefer for project communication. Applications will be delivered to our
 inbox.

title: Experienced E-Commerce Customer Service Representative & Dispute Manager
description:
Our growing e-commerce company is hiring! We are looking for a highly experienced Customer Service Representative & Dispute Manager to join our team for a long-term position.



We operate multiple international e-commerce stores and need someone who has several years of proven experience handling customer service, payment disputes, and chargebacks, particularly through Klarna, PayPal, and Shopify Payments.



IMPORTANT – IMMEDIATE START REQUIRED



Unfortunately, our previous customer service representative has had to leave the business with immediate effect due to health issues. We are therefore looking for an experienced individual who can step into this position as soon as possible.



We already have established systems, SOPs, and previous customer
 conversations available. You will be expected to study previous responses to understand our company's tone, communication style, and how we handle different customer situations.



We are not looking for someone who needs to be taught the basics of customer service or dispute management. We need someone who already understands the industry, can work independently, and is willing to learn our specific workflow.



We are happy to pay more for the right experience and are looking for someone who wants to grow with our company long-term.



What Does a Customer Service Representative & Dispute Manager Do?



You will be responsible for managing day-to-day customer enquiries across our international e-commerce stores, ensuring customers receive professional, helpful, and timely responses.



A significant part of your role will involve handling Klarna, PayPal, and Shopify Payments disputes, gathering supporting evidence, preparing professional dispute responses, and working to minimise unnecessary chargebacks and financial losses.



Because we operate in different countries, you must also be comfortable handling customer
s in multiple languages, using translation tools where necessary while ensuring every response sounds natural, professional, and appropriate for that market.



You will work closely with the company owner and follow our existing SOPs to ensure customer service and dispute management run smoothly.



Responsibilities and Duties



Customer Service: Monitor and respond to customer
s professionally, efficiently, and in accordance with our company policies.



Dispute Management: Independently manage Klarna, PayPal, and Shopify Payments disputes, ensuring evidence is submitted accurately and before deadlines.



Chargeback Prevention: Identify potential disputes early and communicate proactively with customers to resolve issues before they escalate.



Evidence Collection: Gather tracking information, proof of delivery, customer correspondence, order details, and other documentation required for disputes.



Multilingual Customer Support: Handle customer
s in different languages using translation tools, ensuring responses are natural, accurate, and culturally appropriate.



 Tone & Consistency: Study previous customer service conversations to understand and replicate our established tone of voice and approach to different situations.



Refunds & Returns: Handle refund requests, cancellations, returns, and replacement orders in accordance with our policies.



Shipping Issues: Investigate delayed, missing, or incorrectly delivered orders and communicate with suppliers when necessary.



SOP Compliance: Follow our established standard operating procedures carefully and consistently.



Communication: Keep the company owner informed of important issues, urgent disputes, unusual customer situations, and anything requiring approval.



Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring customer issues and suggest improvements to existing processes and workflows.



Qualifications and Skills



Highly Experienced: You have several years of hands-on experience managing customer service and payment disputes for e-commerce businesses.



Klarna & PayPal Expertise: You thoroughly understand how these dispute systems work, what evidence is required, and how to prepare strong, professional responses.



Excellent Written English: Your written communication must be clear, professional, empathetic, and grammatically correct.



Multilingual Capabilities: You are comfortable responding to customers in different languages and can use translation tools effectively.



High Attention to Detail: You understand that overlooking a small detail or missing a dispute deadline can cost the business money.



Independent Problem Solver: You can use your experience and judgement to resolve everyday situations without constantly requiring guidance.



Process-Oriented: You understand the importance of following SOPs and maintaining consistency across customer interactions.



Technically Capable: You are comfortable using Shopify, dispute portals,
 management systems, Slack, and other online tools.



Organised & Reliable: You can manage multiple tasks, prioritise urgent issues, and ensure nothing important is missed.



Willingness to Learn: Although we require experience, you must also be willing to learn how our particular business operates.



Receptive to Feedback: You must be comfortable receiving constructive criticism, taking responsibility for mistakes, and using feedback to improve.



Long-Term Mindset: We want someone who is genuinely interested in building a strong working relationship with our company.



Experience Requirements



Previous e-commerce customer service and dispute management experience is essential.



Ideally, you will have:



At least 3+ years of experience working in e-commerce customer service.



Extensive hands-on experience managing Klarna and PayPal disputes and chargebacks.



Experience managing Shopify Payments disputes.



Previous experience working with international Shopify stores, preferably in dropshipping or direct-to-consumer e-commerce.



Experience handling shipping delays, lost parcels, returns, refunds, and difficult customer situations.



Experience communicating with customers across multiple languages and international markets.



A strong understanding of how to prepare dispute evidence and determine when a dispute should be contested or resolved with a refund.



We will prioritise candidates who can demonstrate genuine experience rather than simply claiming familiarity with these platforms.



Please do not apply if you have little or no practical experience with payment disputes.



Salary Expectations & Working Arrangement



Hourly Rate: $6–$10 USD, depending on experience and capabilities.



We are happy to pay towards the higher end of this range for someone who can demonstrate extensive experience, particularly with Klarna and PayPal dispute management.



There will also be opportunities for pay increases and performance-based bonuses as you demonstrate your abilities, reliability, and value to the company.



Fully remote position.



Long-term working opportunity.



Working hours to be discussed based on experience and availability.



Immediate start preferred.



Potential for additional responsibilities and career progression as the business grows.



We are not simply looking to fill a temporary vacancy. We want someone who can become a reliable, valued member of our team for the foreseeable future.



Benefits



Work remotely from anywhere.



Join an ambitious and growing international e-commerce company.



Competitive hourly compensation based on experience.



Opportunities for salary increases and bonuses for exceptional work.



Established SOPs and workflows to help you settle into the role.



Direct communication with the company owner.



Opportunity to grow professionally and take on greater responsibilities.



A stable, long-term working relationship for the right person.



Our Expectations



We take our customer service and dispute management extremely seriously.



We understand that even experienced individuals need time to familiarise themselves with a new business. However, we expect you to take the initiative to study our existing SOPs, previous
 conversations, and established workflows.



We value people who are intelligent, reliable, proactive, and capable of thinking for themselves.



You must be someone who:



Takes responsibility for their work and mistakes.



Is willing to ask questions when something is unclear rather than make assumptions.



Can receive constructive criticism without taking it personally.



Learns from feedback and actively improves.



Pays close attention to small details.



Communicates clearly and keeps us updated.



Can be trusted to handle important tasks independently.



Genuinely wants to develop and grow alongside the business.



We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work and understands the importance of protecting both our customers' experience and the company's reputation.



If you can commit to these principles, we believe there is an excellent opportunity to build a successful long-term working relationship.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions when submitting your application:



How many years of experience do you have managing e-commerce customer service and payment disputes? Which companies or types of businesses have you worked with?



What is your experience with Klarna and PayPal disputes specifically? Please explain your experience preparing evidence, handling chargebacks, and managing dispute outcomes.



Have you managed customer
s in multiple languages before? Which languages have you handled, and what tools or processes do you use to ensure responses are natural and accurate?



Walk me through your normal dispute management workflow. From receiving a new dispute to submitting evidence and tracking the final outcome, how do you approach the process?



How soon could you start, and how many hours per day or week could you realistically commit?



Are you comfortable studying previous customer
 conversations, following detailed SOPs, and receiving constructive feedback to improve your work?



What hourly rate would you expect based on your previous experience?



Attention to detail test: Please include the phrase "BLUE" at the beginning of your application so we know you have read the full job description.

title: AI Video Editor, DTC Performance Creative
description:
AI Video Editor, DTC Performance Creative (Full-Time)



The role

You’ll be our in-house video editor and AI creative operator. You’ll turn scripts, UGC, raw footage and AI-generated assets into ads that sell. You’ll edit ad variations a week: hooks, bodies, CTAs, formats and aspect ratios. This is not brand-film work. Everything you make is judged on hook rate, hold rate, CTR and CPA.



What you’ll do



Edit direct-response video ads for Meta, TikTok and YouTube: UGC, talking heads, testimonials, founder-style ads, demos and problem/solution ads

Produce hook variations at volume. You’ll take one body and test it against 5–10 openings.

Use AI tools to generate b-roll, product shots, avatars, voiceovers, lip-sync, upscales and scene extensions

Work from scripts and briefs, and push back when a beat isn’t landing

Study top competitor ads and turn what works into our own creative

Keep the asset library, naming conventions and edit templates organized so output scales

Read performance data with the creative strategist and rework losers based on where viewers drop off



What we need to see



3+ years editing performance ads for DTC/ecom brands doing $1M+/yr ($7–8 figures). Show us ads that scaled, not ads that looked nice.

A portfolio of real paid-social ads. Bonus if you can share the results: spend, ROAS or CPA.

Strong editing in Premiere Pro, CapCut and/or DaVinci Resolve. After Effects is a plus.

Hands-on experience across leading AI tools, for example:

Video gen: Veo, Kling, Runway, Seedance, Hailuo, Wan

Image gen: Nano Banana, Flux, GPT Image

Avatars / lip-sync / voice: HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Kling Avatar, InfiniTalk

Enhancement: Topaz, background removal, upscaling

Platforms: fal, kie.ai, Higgsfield or similar

You understand DR fundamentals: the first 3 seconds, pattern interrupts, captions, pacing, offer framing and CTA placement

Fast turnaround without sloppy work. You can ship same-day when a test needs it.



Who you are



Hungry. You want to be the best performance editor in the industry, not just collect a paycheck.

You try new AI tools the week they drop, before anyone asks you to

You think like a marketer and care whether the ad sells, not only whether it looks good

You take feedback without ego and turn it around quickly

You’re organized, communicate well and own your output end to end



Nice to have



Experience with jewelry, wedding or supplement/health brands

Motion graphics and kinetic typography

Basic scripting or hook-writing instincts

Experience with Meta Ads Manager or creative analytics tools like Atria and Motion

title: Creative E-commerce Virtual Assistant – Wix Studio, Product Research, Content Creation & SEO
description:
Company: EasyGreen Interior – Australia

Employment Type: Part-time, with potential to become full-time.

Position: Long-term opportunity



About EasyGreen Interior



EasyGreen Interior is an Australian company specialising in artificial plants, decorative greenery, preserved moss walls and design, custom artificial trees, planters and innovative greenery solutions for residential and commercial spaces.



We work with interior designers, architects, builders, businesses and private customers to create beautiful, natural-looking green environments.



We are currently expanding our e-commerce business and developing our online shop using Wix Studio.



We are looking for a creative, organised, motivated and detail-oriented E-commerce Virtual Assistant to help us build, develop and manage our online store.



Initially, we will provide clear instructions, supplier information and product selections. As you become familiar with our company, we would love you to bring your own ideas, research new opportunities and take greater initiative in helping our online business grow.



Key Responsibilities



1. Product Research & Supplier Catalogue Management



- Research products from supplier websites and catalogues provided by us.

- Collect accurate product information, specifications, dimensions, colours, materials and pricing.

- Identify suitable artificial plants, decorative pots, planters, greenery and home décor products.

- Organise supplier product information and references.

- Research product trends and customer preferences in the Australian market.

- Suggest new products and collections that complement our existing range.

- Identify opportunities for attractive product combinations and bundles.

- Assist with expanding and improving our online product range.



2. Excel / Google Sheets Product Catalogue & Bulk Uploads



An important part of this role is preparing structured product catalogues that can be imported efficiently into our Wix online shop.



You will be responsible for:



- Creating and maintaining a comprehensive product database using Excel or Google Sheets.

- Organising product names, SKUs, supplier references, descriptions, categories, prices, dimensions, colours and variants.

- Recording supplier costs and proposed selling prices.

- Collecting and organising product image links and supporting information.

- Preparing spreadsheets that allow us to easily review and approve products.

- Preparing CSV files compatible with Wix Stores for bulk product uploads.

- Importing approved products into Wix using bulk upload tools.

- Checking product data, images, categories and variants after importing.

- Maintaining and updating the product catalogue as new products become available.

- Creating an organised and efficient product management workflow.



Experience with Excel, Google Sheets and Wix CSV bulk product imports is highly desirable.



3. Creative Product Descriptions & Content Creation



We are looking for someone with strong creative writing skills and a good eye for design who can develop original, attractive and professional product content.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Write unique, engaging and persuasive product descriptions that inspire customers and encourage sales.

- Create attractive and professional product titles suited to our brand.

- Transform supplier information into creative, high-quality product content.

- Highlight each product's features, benefits, styling possibilities and potential applications.

- Develop descriptions suitable for homes, offices, hotels, restaurants, commercial spaces and interior design projects.

- Write in natural, professional Australian English.

- Create SEO-optimised product titles, descriptions and keywords.

- Maintain a consistent, appealing and recognisable brand voice.

- Use AI tools such as ChatGPT to support research, creativity and content development.

- Review and refine content to ensure originality, quality and accuracy.

- Suggest creative product combinations, styling ideas and ways to enhance product presentation.



We value creativity, originality and the ability to present products in a way that makes customers excited to purchase them.



4. Product Images & Visual Presentation



- Collect and organise product images from approved supplier sources.

- Edit, crop, resize and enhance images for a professional online presentation.

- Use Canva or other appropriate editing tools.

- Prepare consistent product images for our website.

- Create attractive visual content for product collections and promotions.

- Assist with lifestyle images and product presentation where appropriate.

- Maintain consistent visual branding across the online shop.

- Suggest improvements to image presentation and product displays.



5. Wix Studio & Online Store Management



- Assist with developing and maintaining our online shop using Wix Studio and Wix Stores.

- Prepare and import approved products using CSV bulk uploads.

- Create and manage product categories and collections.

- Organise product pages and website navigation.

- Ensure products are displayed professionally and consistently.

- Check product images, pricing, descriptions and variants.

- Assist with improving website layout and the customer shopping experience.

- Help maintain an organised, attractive and user-friendly e-commerce website.

- Suggest improvements that could increase customer engagement and online sales.



6. SEO & Digital Marketing Support



- Research relevant keywords for products and categories.

- Optimise product titles, descriptions, image alt text and SEO metadata.

- Improve product discoverability through search engines.

- Assist with creating SEO-friendly category content.

- Research competitors and e-commerce trends in Australia.

- Suggest seasonal promotions, featured collections and marketing opportunities.

- Assist with social media content and product promotions when required.

- Identify opportunities to improve website traffic and conversion rates.



7. Initiative, Product Development & Business Growth



As you gain experience with our products, suppliers and brand, we would like you to become increasingly involved in developing our online business.



This may include:



- Independently researching and recommending new products.

- Identifying emerging trends in artificial plants, greenery and home décor.

- Suggesting new product categories and collections.

- Recommending website improvements and marketing ideas.

- Proposing ways to streamline product management.

- Helping us create a stronger online presence.

- Bringing creative ideas to improve the customer experience and increase sales.



We appreciate people who are curious, enthusiastic, organised and enjoy contributing ideas.



Required Skills & Experience



- Previous experience in e-commerce or online store management.

- Experience using Wix Stores; Wix Studio experience is a strong advantage.

- Good knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.

- Experience preparing product spreadsheets and CSV files for bulk imports.

- Strong creative writing skills in English.

- Experience writing engaging product descriptions.

- Good understanding of SEO principles.

- Experience with product research and supplier catalogues.

- Basic graphic design or photo editing skills, particularly Canva.

- Confidence using AI tools to improve efficiency and creativity.

- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.

- Good communication and time management.

- Ability to follow instructions and progressively work independently.



Experience in home décor, interior design, furniture, artificial plants, landscaping or lifestyle e-commerce would be a great advantage.



Please send us the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your previous experience.

2. Details of your Wix Stores or Wix Studio experience.

3. Examples of online shops or e-commerce websites you have worked on.

4. Examples of product descriptions you have personally created.

5. Details of your experience with Excel, Google Sheets and CSV bulk product uploads.

6. Your experience with product image editing, SEO and product research.

7. Your expected hourly rate in AUD.

8. Your weekly availability.



Please start your application with the words "GREEN SHOP" so we know you have read the job description carefully.



We are looking forward to finding a motivated and creative person who would like to grow with EasyGreen Interior and help us develop an exciting online shopping experience.

title: Remote Phone Sales Rep – Warm Leads, Short 10–15 Min Calls, $10 per Sale
description:
About us

We help people trade the financial markets with AI-powered tools and funded trading capital, without risking their own savings. We are expanding into the US market and are building our phone sales team.



Why this role is different

You don’t chase anyone. Every US lead you call has:



applied through our form

watched our 20-minute info webinar

been fully briefed by our support team



They already know what we offer and what it costs. They’re warm and expecting our call. Your job is to answer their last questions and help them get started.



The role

You make short, focused calls of 10–15 minutes to US leads: confirm their goals, clear up any hesitation and close them on our entry program ($179) right on the call. No cold calling, no prospecting.



What you’ll do



Call warm US leads from your call lists in our CRM (Close, with a built-in power dialer)

Build rapport quickly and confirm the lead’s interest and goals

Answer remaining questions clearly and honestly

Handle common objections such as timing, trust or “I need to think about it”

Close on the call, send the checkout link and follow up until payment is complete

Follow up with leads you couldn’t reach

Log every call: short notes, status and next step



What we’re looking for



Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent

1+ year of phone sales or BPO sales experience; experience calling US customers is a big plus

Confident, friendly and to the point: you can close on the first call without being pushy

Organized, reliable and clean with CRM notes

Night shift: your shift falls within 10 am – 10 pm US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday

Quiet home workspace, stable internet with a backup (e.g. mobile data) and a noise-cancelling headset

You never make income or profit promises, and you follow US calling rules (calls only between 9 am and 9 pm in the lead’s local time)



Compensation (paid monthly in USD)



$750 base in month 1, then $1,000/month once you reach 60 sales in a month

+ $15 commission per sale, no cap

Full-time reps closing 3–5 sales per day earn $1,900–$2,500/month from month 2

Commission is paid on completed, non-refunded sales

Independent contractor, fully home-based



What you get



Warm, pre-educated US leads only: no cold calling

Short calls with a simple offer, so you close on the first call

A proven process that already works in our European market

A growth path into a high-ticket closer role



To apply

Send a 60–90 second voice note or video introducing yourself in English, and answer these 3 questions:



What have you sold by phone before, and what was your close rate?

A lead says “It sounds good, but I need to think about it.” What do you say?

Can you work US hours (night shift in PH time), Monday to Friday?

title: Bureau Caller (Remote)
description:
About the role

You phone the credit bureaus about client disputes, confirm what was filed, get reference numbers and outcomes, and log every call in our portal the same day. This is a remote, full-time independent contractor position with a fixed weekly base pay.



What you will do



Call Equifax, Experian and TransUnion on behalf of our clients’ files.

On every call, get the outcome, a reference or confirmation number, and the representative’s name or ID.

Log every call in the portal the same day, including calls that did not connect.

title: Virtual Assistant For Social Media
description:
Hi future teammate!



I run a social media platform and am looking for a VA I can trust to project manage all my social media platforms and who eventually I can form a long-term working relationship with. I am based in Singapore, so we are in the same time zone. I have a VA who has been my trusty right hand woman and I’m looking for another to join the team. This will be a full time role.



Primary tasks will include:

-use my existing blog content/videos to organise the information in a short form post

- Able to write and present information in a clear concise and helpful flow for readers. These include key benefits, features, eligibility & fees and current promotions etc.

- Analyse similar social media accounts and create relevant content

- Analyse website and social media statistics and make recommendations on how to improve follower count, engagement rate etc.

- Tracking / recording / data entry tasks for KPI management

- Other administrative tasks and SOPs, as they come up

- all tools, training and support will be provided!



There are three phases to this job:

Set Up:

In this stage, you will be doing a lot of project management work. I will have my content calendar for the month. You will help me to write video captions, hashtags, prepare
 blast, create cover images using the templates provided and upload the videos or content. You will need to communicate with the video editor of changes of what parts to cut from a video to shorten videos to 1 min for Youtube shorts posting, as well as think of ways that we can create content in the most effective and efficient manner - for Tiktok, IG, Youtube etc. You will need to analyse the social media data to tell me your observations and recommendations for each platform. You will also vet through all videos before submitting to me.

Maintenance:

In this second stage, you will have a fundamental knowledge and rhythm of managing my content platforms. You will begin to propose videos for my content calendar and start having creative direction if you are able to.

Proposal:

At the third stage, you know the brand and product at the back of your finger tips and you are able to know what works and what doesn’t work for our brand on social media to bring in the follower, engagement and sales. If we both don’t know how to do it, it is fine, you will be given the space and time to research and figure out what we can try and what works.



Who should apply:

- Someone with high attention to detail and able to execute data research and workflow well

- Someone with a good command of English who can write well

Previous mortgage industry experience is strongly preferred. Candidates should have relevant experience in mortgage, lending, or real estate.

﻿Respond promptly to incoming online leads through phone calls, SMS, and

Qualify leads by asking relevant questions about their goals, timelines, financing needs, and readiness to proceed. Book qualified consultations directly into the mortgage broker's calendar. Consistently follow up with leads who have not responded or are not yet ready to book. Handle initial questions and objections professionally to encourage appointment bookings. Maintain accurate CRM records, lead statuses, conversation notes, and follow-up activities. Ensure leads are consistently followed up with and opportunities are not missed.

﻿Proactively contact past clients to conduct annual mortgage reviews and relationship check-ins. Identify opportunities involving mortgage renewals, refinancing, home purchases, investment properties, and other financing needs. Reconnect with dormant clients and previously unconverted prospects. Build relationships that encourage repeat business and client referrals. Schedule mortgage review appointments when opportunities are identified. Maintain an organized follow-up schedule and accurate client records.



3. CRM Management & Performance Tracking

﻿Manage lead pipelines, client information, activities, and follow-up tasks in the CRM. Track new leads contacted, conversations, qualified appointments booked, and opportunities identified. title: Credit Repair Disputing Manager — Build or Lead a VA Team (DisputeFox Required)
description:
**Credit Repair Disputing Manager — Build & Lead a VA Team**  

**DisputeFox Required | GoHighLevel Preferred**



Hi there!



We’re a U.S.-based credit repair company with **215+ active clients**, and we’re looking for an experienced Disputing Manager to build and lead a dependable VA team. This is NOT  an entry level role.



We care about our clients and work hard to give them a **premium experience**. We have clear SOPs and established systems, and we’d love to find a proactive, organized leader who brings fresh ideas, solves problems, and takes pride in their team’s work.



Our owner is friendly, approachable, and open to suggestions. We value a comfortable working relationship where everyone communicates, follows through, and feels welcome to contribute.



**We’re looking to hire during November 15–21, 2026, and would love for you to begin onboarding within 24–48 hours of receiving an offer.**



**WHAT YOU’LL HELP WITH**



These are the main responsibilities. We’ll discuss the full scope together during the interview.



- Bring or recruit qualified dispute processors for owner approval.

- Organize assignments, manage workloads, train staff, and plan backup coverage.

- Oversee credit report reviews and accurate dispute processing using our SOPs.

- Keep DisputeFox records, client statuses, and follow-up dates organized and current.

- Review work quality and help team members improve.

- Share daily updates on completed work, challenges, and next steps.

- Suggest ways to improve our internal processes and client experience.

- Keep up with credit reporting changes, bureau procedures, and industry developments, and share recommendations.



**HOW WE WORK TOGETHER**



You’ll lead daily operations and be accountable for your team’s performance. We’re looking for someone who plans ahead, follows up, and notices when something needs attention.



When challenges come up, keep us informed, explore solutions, and help the team move forward. Your ideas are welcome! We’ll review proposed process changes together before putting them into action.



**We want to get to know our team.** Everyone working on our files will be introduced and approved. We’ll use shared company channels and regular meetings so the owner and team can communicate directly and build rapport.



Working with other credit repair companies is fine, as long as your team has enough capacity to give our clients consistent attention and meet agreed deadlines.



**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**



- Hands-on **DisputeFox** experience.

- Experience leading and training credit repair VAs.

- Strong credit report analysis and dispute-processing skills.

- Experience with late payments, bankruptcies, and complex files.

- Proactive, strategic thinking and strong organization.

- Clear written and spoken English.

- Attention to detail, good judgment, and reliable follow-through.

- Dependable internet, backup arrangements, and careful handling of client information.

- Availability for scheduled U.S. Central Time meetings.



We primarily work **Monday–Friday**. Occasional weekend availability would be helpful during busy seasons, special projects, or promotions to prevent backlogs. We’ll agree on weekend coverage and compensation in advance.



**HELPFUL ADDITIONAL SKILLS**



- **GoHighLevel:** conversations, contacts, notes, tasks, pipelines, and follow-ups.

- Client onboarding, customer support, and bureau calls.

- Content support: short video editing, captions, repurposing footage, and scheduling posts.



Graphic design isn’t needed. Additional services can be quoted separately.



**PAY & GETTING STARTED**



Our target budget is **$5–$10 per assigned active client per month**, depending on what’s included.



We’d prefer to make **one consolidated payment to the manager**, who handles paying the approved team.



Please explain what your rate covers, including management, processing, quality checks, and reporting. List any additional costs for FTC report preparation, customer support, content, mailing, or other services.



We’ll agree on the scope, deadlines, billing, and paid onboarding together. We’ll start with a **paid test of approximately 25–50 clients for one full dispute round** before expanding assignments.



**INTERESTED? WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU!**



Start your application with **“Crystal Clear Leadership.”** Send your résumé and brief answers to these four questions:



1. Tell us about your experience managing credit repair teams, using DisputeFox, and working in GoHighLevel.

2. Do you have a team available, or would you recruit one? How many companies and client files do you currently support?

3. What is your monthly per-client rate, and what does it include?

4. When could you begin onboarding? Please include your weekday hours and occasional weekend availability in U.S. Central and Philippine Time.



We’ll contact selected applicants with next steps.



**We’re excited to meet someone who values teamwork, thoughtful leadership, organized work, and taking great care of clients.**

title: GTA 6 Gameplay Recorder - Record on Your PS5 or Xbox Series X or S
description:
We run several YouTube channels, and we're hiring gameplay recorders for Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6), out on 19 November 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. You need your own console and a way to record on it. We buy your copy of the game once you're hired and send you a list of what to record each day, and you hand back clean clips for our videos: glitches, stunts, hidden details and "what happens if" tests. We may hire more than one person, and we're looking for people to work with us on an ongoing basis.



Speed matters. Most glitches turn up in the first days after release, and the best ones get patched. We want each one recorded the day it's found, clearly enough that a viewer could copy it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Install the game and be ready to play from release day.



- Record what's on our list each day: a glitch someone has reported, a stunt, a hidden detail, or a test such as "what happens if you drive a boat onto the highway?".



- Test each reported glitch and tell us plainly whether it works, and what you tried when it didn't.



- Hunt for your own. When something breaks or surprises you, save the last few minutes straight away (the PS5's "Save Recent Gameplay" or the Xbox's "Record what happened"), then work out how to make it happen again.



- Record every clip to our settings (below).



- Upload the original files to our shared Google Drive the same day, and add a note for each to our Google Sheet: what it is, where on the map, the steps, and how often it works.



- Send a short update on 
 at the end of each session.



HOW WE NEED IT RECORDED



- 1080p or higher, saved as MP4, with HDR switched off so the colours don't wash out in editing.



- Game sound only: no microphone, no party chat and nothing playing in the room. The in-game radio stays off unless we ask, because its songs get videos claimed.



- Notifications and trophy or achievement pop-ups turned off.



- Each clip starts a few seconds before the action and runs a few seconds after it. No cutting or editing: we want the file as it was recorded.



- For a glitch, show where it is on the map, then do the steps slowly enough to copy, then do it at least twice.



EXAMPLE NOTE (an imaginary glitch, to show the detail we need)



"Car falls through bridge. The steel bridge on the north road out of the port, second lane from the right, about halfway across. Any four-door car at full speed. Didn't work on a motorbike. Worked 3 times out of 5. Clips: bridge-01 to bridge-05."



Record only in the game as sold, on your own account: no mods, cheats, modified consoles or leaked copies. The clips are ours to publish, so don't post them on your own channels or share them.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Your own PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X or Xbox Series S, with at least 230 GB free for the game. GTA 6 isn't out on PS4, Xbox One or PC.



- Experience recording gameplay on that console, with clips or videos you can link.



- A way to record at least 30 minutes without a break. On an Xbox that usually means an external drive or a capture card.



- A way to get the original files from your console to Google Drive (usually a USB drive and a computer), and internet that can upload several gigabytes a day.



- Many hours in GTA V, GTA Online or similar open-world games, and a feel for where games break: walls, water, vehicles and odd corners of the map.



- English good enough to follow written instructions exactly and write clear notes.



- Time for about 40 hours a week from release day, and reliable replies on 
.



- You're 18 or older.



- Bonus: a capture card, your own gaming channel, or glitches you've found yourself.



Workload: About 40 hours a week, starting on release day, 19 November. The game and the daily list are supplied.



Turnaround: Anything on the daily list recorded and uploaded within 24 hours. Your own finds uploaded the same day.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "grape" and include:



1. Your
 address



2. Your console and recording setup: which console (PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X or Xbox Series S), the country its account is set to, whether you record with the console itself or a capture card, the resolution and frames per second you record at, and the longest recording you can make without a break



3. A photo and a test clip, in one Google Drive folder set so anyone with the link can view: the photo shows your console and controller beside a handwritten note with the code word and today's date, and the clip is 1–2 minutes you recorded on that console this week from any game, uploaded as the original file with game sound only



4. Links to gameplay videos you recorded yourself, where each was posted and what you did on it (or "none yet")



5. Your GTA history: which GTA games you've played, roughly how many hours in each, and any glitches you've found or copied yourself (or "none yet")



6. Your answer to this imaginary moment: you're driving across a bridge in GTA 6 and your car drops straight through the road into the water, and nobody has reported it yet. What do you do in the next ten minutes, in 2–4 sentences?



7. A speedtest.net result you ran today (link)



8. Your expected rate (per hour or per month)



9. Your hours: whether you can work 40 hours a week from 19 November, and the hours you'd work each day (Philippine time)



10. Your 
 username



Applications that skip the code word or any of items 1–9 won't be reviewed.

title: Senior Financial Controller / Finance Manager |Multi-Store International E-Commerce | Remote
description:
Senior Financial Controller / Finance Manager



Multi-Store International E-Commerce | Remote



We are a fast-growing international e-commerce company operating multiple Shopify stores across several countries and processing significant transaction volumes through multiple payment providers.



We are looking for a highly capable Senior Financial Controller / Finance Manager to professionalize and take ownership of our finance function.



This is NOT a junior bookkeeping position.



We already have finance/accounting activities taking place inside the company. We need a senior finance professional who can ensure that our numbers are accurate, our controls are strong and management has reliable financial information for decision-making.



Your Mission



Build a finance function that the founder can trust.



You will assess our current finance processes, identify weaknesses, improve controls and reporting, and oversee the people performing recurring finance work.



Responsibilities



* Own financial reporting and financial accuracy

* Review and improve our current finance processes

* Oversee bookkeeping and accounting workflows

* Review reconciliations across banks and payment processors

* Ensure Shopify/order data reconciles correctly with financial records

* Monitor payment processor settlements and fees

* Review supplier payments and COGS

* Improve expense categorization and controls

* Monitor refunds, chargebacks and payment-related losses

* Produce reliable monthly P&L reporting

* Produce consolidated and store-level management reporting

* Develop cash-flow reporting and forecasting

* Build budgets and forecasts

* Identify unusual financial movements and discrepancies

* Establish appropriate approval and financial control processes

* Review the work of junior finance/accounting team members

* Improve month-end closing procedures

* Work with external accountants, tax advisers and other specialists where required

* Help management understand profitability and financial performance

* Identify opportunities for financial automation and better systems



E-Commerce Complexity



Experience with high-volume e-commerce is strongly preferred.



Our environment may include:



* Multiple Shopify stores

* Multiple currencies

* Multiple countries

* Stripe

* Shopify Payments

* PayPal

* Klarna and other payment methods

* Refunds

* Chargebacks

* Supplier payments

* Advertising spend

* FX

* Payment processor fees



You should be comfortable reconciling complex transaction flows rather than only traditional invoice-based businesses.



What We Are Looking For



* Strong accounting/finance foundation

* Significant experience in financial control, finance management or senior accounting

* Excellent reconciliation skills

* Strong management reporting ability

* Experience creating or improving financial controls

* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills

* Experience with accounting software such as Xero or QuickBooks

* High attention to detail

* Strong analytical ability

* Ability to investigate discrepancies independently

* Ability to review and challenge the work of others

* Strong written English



CPA/ACCA/CIMA or comparable professional qualifications are highly valued but not automatically required if your experience is exceptional.



What We Are NOT Looking For



This is not suitable for someone whose experience is primarily:



* Data entry

* Basic bookkeeping

* Accounts payable only

* Virtual assistance

* Producing reports without understanding the underlying numbers



We need someone capable of owning and controlling a finance function, not simply processing transactions.



What Success Looks Like



Management can confidently answer:



* How profitable are we?

* Which stores are most profitable?

* What is our real COGS?

* Where is our cash?

* What are our payment processor balances?

* Are all transactions reconciled?

* What are our major financial risks?

* How are actual results performing against forecast?



And most importantly: management can trust the answers.



Application



Please answer:



1. What is the largest company, measured by annual revenue or transaction volume, for which you have personally managed or controlled finance?

2. Describe the most complex reconciliation environment you have worked with.

3. Have you worked with Shopify, Stripe, PayPal or similar payment processors? Explain exactly what you were responsible for.

4. Tell us about a significant financial discrepancy or control problem you personally discovered. How did you find it and what happened?

5. Which financial reports did you personally prepare or review each month?

6. Have you managed or reviewed the work of other accountants/bookkeepers? How many?

7. Which accounting qualifications do you hold?

8. Which accounting systems are you strongest with?

9. What is your current availability and expected monthly compensation for a full-time position?



Begin your application with FINANCIAL CONTROL.

title: AutoCAD Drafter — US Residential Permit Drawings (ADU Revisions), Project-Based
description:
Hi! We're a small California construction / real estate team (Riverside, CA). Three ADU permits are in City plan-check corrections, and our previous drafter had to leave mid-project — so we're looking for a drafter to take over and hopefully stay with us long-term. The DWG files and the City's correction list are complete. The work is revising architectural sheets (site plan, floor plan, roof plan, details, electrical) following our written instructions and the City's comments, until the permits are issued. It's a takeover, not a redesign. If we work well together, there's more coming: the other sets in this project, plus future projects.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong AutoCAD 2D architectural drafting (please tell us your version); comfortable in imperial units (feet/inches)

- Experience with US residential permit drawings (California / ADU experience is a plus); able to read City correction comments in English

- Willing to share one permit set you've submitted before (redacted is fine) so we can see your work

- Responsive (within 1 business day), honest about deadlines, and happy to ask questions instead of guessing — we always prefer a question over a wrong guess



A FEW THINGS THAT MATTER A LOT TO US (the City is strict — following these saves us both a lot of rework):

- Each round, please send the editable DWG together with the PDF

- All-black linework with normal lineweights and easy-to-read text; please keep text as real text (not outlined)

- A revision cloud + delta on every change, with a short change list matched to the City's comment numbers

- When a dimension changes, please move the actual geometry, not just the dimension text

- If a dimension ever conflicts with field measurements, please stop and ask us first — we'd much rather answer than fix it later



PAY

Fixed price per round (per sheet, or per round of 3–4 sheets) — please quote us. We pay after each round passes our check, via Wise or PayPal, and we pay on time, every time. To start, we'd like to do one paid trial sheet together; if it goes well, the full set is yours.



TO APPLY, PLEASE ANSWER THESE 5 QUICK QUESTIONS:

1. Have you done US permit drawings before? Where, and what project types (any ADUs?)

2. Could you link or attach one permit set you've drafted? (Redacted is OK)

3. Which AutoCAD version do you use?

4. Your fixed price for: (a) the one-sheet trial, (b) one round of 3–4 sheets

5. Your usual turnaround for a round, and your working hours vs California time (PST)



We read every application and will reply to everyone who answers the questions. Thank you — we look forward to meeting you!

title: Events Coordinator and Community Manager (Part-Time)
description:
The company

 A private, application-only membership community for founders and business owners, operating across several US markets. Members meet at invitation-only social events, stay connected through a members-only mobile app, and receive curated one-to-one introductions.



What this role is

 You run the event calendar. The flagship is a recurring invitation-only evening event held in each market every other month, which means an event somewhere roughly every two weeks, plus virtual sessions members get each week. The bar is high: small rooms, hand-picked guests, rooftops and pool decks, no name badges and no conference energy. Your job is to keep that calendar full, those rooms full, and the founders on schedule.



Venue sourcing and event production

- Find and secure venues that fit a premium brand: rooftops, pool decks, private rooms in strong hotels and restaurants, spaces that photograph well

- Cold outreach to venues, GMs and event managers: pitch, negotiate rate or comp, hold the date, close it

- Build a standing venue shortlist in each market so the next event is never a scramble

- Own the run of show: timing, check-in, food and beverage, vendors, AV where needed

- Keep a forward calendar across all markets so dates lock months out, not weeks



Guest list and attendance

- Curate the invite list per event. Who is in the room matters more than how many.

- Run the RSVP push across SMS,
 and in-app notifications

- Chase RSVPs person by person until the room is full. No blast and hope.

- Follow up after each event: thank-yous, feedback, re-engagement of no-shows



Virtual sessions

- Run the weekly cadence: a mastermind and an industry roundtable on alternating weeks

- Group the right members onto each industry call by sector and stage

- Line up and brief the guest for each session

- Send invites, confirm the roster, chase attendance



Promotion and creator outreach

- Reach out to creators and partners who can post about events and bring the right people

- Keep event listings and in-app content current

- Pull usable material out of every event: photos, clips, recaps



- Follow-through

- Track what the founders and the team owe each event, and chase it

- Hold people to their dates, warmly and persistently

- Flag risk early: venue unconfirmed, RSVPs light, no guest booked



Required

- Two or more years running events, community programs, or high-touch coordination

- Venue sourcing and negotiation experience, with specific spaces secured and terms achieved

- A track record of filling rooms, with real attendance numbers

- Brand judgment. Can tell a venue that fits a premium membership brand from one that does not.

- Excellent spoken and written English, confident cold-calling US venue managers and talking with founders

- Interpersonal warmth paired with the backbone to hold people to commitments

- Highly organized, works from a system, never needs reminding twice



Nice to have

- Hospitality, nightlife, or private-club events background

- Experience inside a membership or founder community

- Light content work: recaps, social posts, short clips

- Comfortable in CRM tools, SMS platforms, and mobile app admin



Very nice to have

- Has procured vendor or brand sponsorships for events, and can name what they closed and on what terms

- Has negotiated content or media partnership deals
