Start your message with the word **"ACRIS."** Then include:

1. **A 60-second voice recording** introducing yourself as if you were calling a New York property owner

title: AI VSL/UGC editor
description:
I’m the founder of a new e-commerce brand, and I’m building my dream team from the ground up, starting with YOU.



This is a rare opportunity to be the FIRST editor on board. You won’t be just another freelancer in a crowd. You’ll be employee #1 on the creative side. As the brand scales, the people who joined early get the first shot at bigger roles, more responsibility and leadership positions.



When I grow, you grow. That’s the deal.



Your responsibilities



- Primary focus: long-form VSLs (2+ minutes). Structure hook → problem → agitation → solution → proof → offer, with pacing that holds attention for minutes, not just a 15-second hook.

- Create realistic AI video. Generate lifelike b-roll, scenes and characters that blend seamlessly with real footage, with no uncanny faces, warped hands or glitchy motion.

- Keep AI content consistent. The same character, product and lighting across multiple clips and scenes.

- Produce AI voiceovers and lip-sync that sound natural and on-brand.

- Edit with clean cuts, captions, b-roll and sound design.

- Know where to find quality stock footage and music, and when AI is the better option.

- Keep project files organised (note: start your application with the word PIXEL).

- Turn edits around quickly and handle revisions without ego.



Who I’m looking for:

Someone hungry and creative who wants to actually matter. Mindset over résumé: fast, organised, detail-obsessed, takes ownership, and handles feedback without taking it personally.



- Solid written and spoken English

- Proven experience editing direct response VSLs that convert, not just short-form social cuts

- Hands-on experience with current AI video tools, such as Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Runway, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Midjourney and Freepik. You know which tool is best for which shot.

- You keep up with new AI tools and models as they’re released, and test them yourself.

- Intent-driven editing: every hook, cut and caption has a purpose across the full runtime

- Editing speed

- You actually care whether your ad performed



The details:

- Rate: $4/hour

- Hours: per project and flexible to start, with room to grow into steady weekly hours

- Payment: weekly via Wise



How to apply:

- A short intro about yourself

- Links to 3 of your best edits, at least one a VSL of 2+ minutes

- At least 1 example of realistic AI video you created, with the tools you used

- Your AI workflow in 3–5 sentences: how you generate a realistic clip, and how you keep characters consistent

- The software you use and your years of experience

- Your weekly availability



Shortlisted applicants complete a short paid test edit.



Bonus points for a quick Loom video introducing yourself. It’s not required, but it stands out.

title: Remote Construction & FF&E Procurement Coordinator (US PST Night Shift)
description:
Remote FF&E & Design Procurement Coordinator (US PST Night Shift)



Type: Full-time, 40 hours/week

Schedule: Night shift, Pacific Time — 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST (1:00 AM – 10:00 AM PHT, or 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM PHT during daylight saving)

Pay: $6/hour, inclusive of night differential, commensurate with experience

About the Studio

We are a boutique interior design studio in Los Angeles focused exclusively on commercial projects. Because we are small and fast-moving, you will work directly with the Principal Designer every day, keeping materials, finishes, and furnishings moving smoothly from concept to installation.



The Role

We are looking for an organized, design-minded FF&E & Procurement Coordinator to own the full procurement cycle for our projects — sourcing, specification, quoting, purchasing, and delivery tracking of finishes and Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment (FF&E). You will be the central link between our design studio, trade showrooms, manufacturer reps, and installers.

What You Will Do

•	Source materials and furnishings: Contact lighting, tile, plumbing, hardware, and furniture showrooms and reps for trade pricing, stock, lead times, freight quotes, and physical samples.

•	Manage specifications: Build, organize, and audit finish, lighting fixture, and hardware schedules in Excel/Google Sheets, keeping every spec aligned with the approved design.

•	Support design documentation: Compile manufacturer cut sheets, installation guides, and CAD blocks into clean, organized packages for contractor coordination.

•	Handle purchasing: Draft purchase orders, check vendor invoices line by line against approved quotes and design documents, and confirm finishes, dimensions, and quantities before payment.

•	Track orders and deliveries: Follow production timelines, backorders, shipments, and freight to job sites or receiving warehouses, and flag delays early.

•	Coordinate meetings: Schedule design presentations, vendor calls, and project meetings, prepare agendas, take clear notes, and circulate action items to the team and vendors.

•	Follow up
 Call and
 US showrooms, vendors, and installers during LA business hours on our company VoIP line to resolve discrepancies and secure updates.

What You Bring

•	2+ years in design procurement, FF&E purchasing, showroom coordination, or architectural support — ideally gained inside an architecture, interior design, or construction firm, and ideally with US-based clients.

•	A proven, sustainable routine for working a full US night shift (PST or EST).

•	The ability to read floor plans, elevations, and spec sheets — dimensions, finish codes, and material details.

•	Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and the ability to learn new design and project tools quickly (we will train you on our studio’s software).

•	Fluent, professional written and spoken English for daily contact with US reps and vendors.

•	A reliable home office: fiber internet (50 Mbps minimum), a verified backup connection, backup power, and a quiet space for calls.

Bonus Points

•	CAD ability — our top preference. Comfortable working with CAD drawings and blocks to compile manufacturer cut sheets and installation guides into coordinated packages.

•	A degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.

•	Familiarity with design materials — tile, architectural lighting, plumbing and door hardware, and commercial furnishings.

•	Experience working with trade showrooms and design reps (e.g., building product libraries and sample programs).

•	Hands-on experience with Programa, Procore, Bluebeam, or Studio Designer.

•	Prior experience working on a US-based architecture, interior design, or construction team.

How to Apply

Send your resume with a short cover message answering these three questions. Applications without answers will not be reviewed.

1.	Which design, project, or documentation tools have you used (e.g., Excel, CAD, or design software), and how?

2.	Describe a time you caught an error in a quote, spec sheet, or purchase order before production or delivery.

3.	Confirm you can work 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST full-time, and briefly describe your primary and backup internet and power setup.

title: Youtube Long Form Video Editor and Photo Management
description:
We're looking for a detail-obsessed video editor to join our growing media team and take ownership of long-form YouTube content for two channels: Video Agency and the founder's personal YouTube channel. This is not a copy-and-paste editing role. We want someone who understands storytelling, pacing, and how to keep viewers watching from the first minute to the last.

You'll edit long-form YouTube videos from raw footage to a polished, color-graded final, and quality-check photos before they're delivered to clients.



Non-Negotiable Requirements

• Must be familiar with Final Cut Pro (preferred). Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve is also fine

• Must have experience editing long-form YouTube content

• Must know how to color correct and color grade

• Must have strong attention to detail

• Must be willing to learn, grow, and adapt

• Must be reliable with communication and deadlines



What You'll Do

• Edit long-form YouTube videos from raw footage to upload-ready

• Build pacing and story that keep viewers watching through the whole video

• Clean up audio, cut dead air, and add music, sound design, b-roll, titles and captions

• Color correct and grade every video for a consistent, premium look

• Quality-check real estate photos for editing mistakes before delivery

• Watch every video in full before delivery to catch errors in audio, text, color and continuity



What We're Looking For

We want someone who:

• Understands YouTube retention and how to hook viewers early

• Catches the small things others miss: an audio pop, a mismatched shot, a crooked horizon

• Has an eye for music selection, sound design, transitions, and composition

• Can make footage feel modern, clean, and premium

• Takes ownership of quality, not just speed



Bonus If You Have Experience With

• Real estate or lifestyle content

• Photo editing (Lightroom, Photoshop)

• Motion graphics

• Thumbnail design

• YouTube content strategy

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Venom Motorsports | Reels, TikTok & YouTube Shorts
description:
We sell motorcycles, ATVs, and other powersports vehicles at Venom Motorsports. Our on-camera team shoots product demos, walkarounds, and scripted videos. We're looking for an experienced editor who can find the strongest moment in the footage and build a video people want to finish.



Say we film a walkaround and the best moment is the actor firing up the bike halfway through. You might open on the engine start, use the actor's best line to set up the story, then cut back to the details viewers came to see. That's the kind of judgment we want you to bring to each edit.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Turn raw footage into vertical videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

• Build strong openings, choose the best takes, and use B-roll and cutaways to keep the story moving.

• Add accurate English captions, clean up dialogue, and balance music and effects with sounds worth hearing, like the engine or the actor's delivery.

• Suggest alternate openings when the footage supports them, revise from feedback, and keep project files organized for handoff.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A portfolio of short-form edits that shows strong pacing and storytelling, especially with a presenter or a physical product.

• Good judgment about when to cut, when to let a moment breathe, and when to use graphics or effects.

• Reliable turnaround and clear communication. Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut are all welcome. Automotive or powersports work is a plus.



PAY & AVAILABILITY

$4–$5 USD per hour, based on your portfolio and experience. Remote, Philippines-based. Share your weekly availability when you apply.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Send direct links to 2–3 short-form videos you personally edited. Include one presenter-led or product video if you have one, and tell us what parts of each edit you handled.

2. Pick one of those videos. In 2–3 sentences, explain why you opened it the way you did and one cut or sound choice that kept it moving.

3. Tell us your editing software, weekly availability, and how long you typically need to deliver a first cut of a 30–60 second video.



EDITING EXERCISE FOR SHORTLISTED APPLICANTS

We’ll ask shortlisted applicants to turn one clip from Venom Motorsports into a 15–30 second vertical video (9:16). Choose the opening yourself, trim the footage so the story moves, and keep any dialogue clear with easy-to-read captions. We’ll look at what you chose to open with, what you cut, and how you used sound.



Source footage: 



Send your portfolio first. If you’re shortlisted, we’ll confirm the details before you start the exercise.

title: Zoho CRM Developer & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Teal Bay Capital is looking for a hands-on **Zoho CRM & Digital Marketing Specialist** to customize our Zoho environment, connect website and marketing activity to our commercial funding pipeline, and use AI to improve content creation and lead follow-up.



**What you’ll do**



- **Zoho CRM and Zoho One.** Configure deal stages, custom fields, permissions, workflows, integrations, and dashboards. Route website inquiries and referrals to the right team member for follow-up.

- **Base44.** Maintain website pages and intake forms. Test changes to confirm that inquiries reach Zoho with the correct lead source and assignment.

- **AI, Pressmaster, and social media.** Use AI and Pressmaster to research topics, draft and repurpose content, and maintain a publishing calendar. Review content for accuracy and brand consistency before it goes through approval.

- **RankGPT and Traxy.** Use RankGPT to support search and AI visibility reporting. Help evaluate and implement Traxy, document how it fits into the marketing workflow, and track results.

- **Reporting.** Track inquiries, qualified opportunities, and funded deals by source so leadership can see which marketing efforts generate business.



**What you’ll bring**



- Strong, hands-on experience administering and customizing Zoho CRM. Experience with the broader Zoho One suite is strongly preferred. Be ready to walk through a workflow or integration you personally built and tested.

- Practical experience using AI tools and social media platforms for content creation, publishing, and performance reporting.

- A working understanding of Base44, Pressmaster, RankGPT, and Traxy. Hands-on experience with any of these platforms is preferred.

- Clear written English, attention to detail, and sound judgment when handling sensitive borrower information and public-facing financing content.



**Compensation and 90-day review**



Base salary is **$950–$1,200 USD per month, plus performance-based bonus opportunities**. The starting salary within that range will reflect your demonstrated Zoho and digital marketing experience. Bonus eligibility and criteria will be outlined in writing.



At the start of the role, we’ll agree on priorities and how we’ll measure success. At 90 days, we’ll review whether website inquiries are reliably captured and assigned in Zoho, qualified opportunities can be traced to their source, and approved content is published consistently. We’ll use that review to discuss performance, next priorities, and whether a base salary adjustment is warranted.

title: YouTube Thumbnail for B2C Info-Business Channels
description:
About Us

We work with B2C info businesses (coaches, course creators, and education-based brands) to grow their YouTube channels and paid acquisition. Our focus isn't chasing viral views — it's building watch time, trust, and conversions that turn viewers into customers, leads, and buyers. We're looking for a designer who understands that a thumbnail's job is to earn the click while staying true to the brand, not just look flashy.



INSPO OF THE STYLE WE ARE LOOKING FOR:









The Role

We need a graphic designer who specializes in YouTube thumbnails and can also support with related visual assets for our channels and campaigns.



Heads up on how this starts: we're beginning with a small, low-volume workload as a trial run. This isn't a red flag on the role — it's how we bring everyone in. Once we see the quality and reliability of your work and more trust is built, expect to receive more work on a consistent basis.



What You'll Be Doing



Designing custom YouTube thumbnails for long-form videos — high-CTR, on-brand, and tailored to what performs in the info-business/coaching space

Iterating on thumbnail concepts based on performance data or feedback (not just "make it pop," but understanding why something clicks)

Keeping a consistent visual identity across a channel's thumbnails so the brand is instantly recognizable

Supporting with occasional related graphics — channel art, end screens, social posts, or simple ad creative assets

Organizing and naming files clearly so assets are easy to find and reuse

Taking notes/feedback and turning revisions around quickly and without back-and-forth



What We're Looking For



Proven experience designing YouTube thumbnails specifically — not just general graphic design with no YouTube portfolio

An eye for what drives clicks in the B2C/coaching/course-creator space: clear value proposition, strong facial expressions/emotion, legible text, and contrast — without looking clickbait-y or cheap

Strong skills in Photoshop, Canva, or similar design tools

Understanding of what makes content convert (clarity, credibility, curiosity) vs. what's just "viral bait" — we care about the former

Ability to work from a brand style guide and keep visual consistency across many thumbnails over time

Reliable communicator, meets deadlines, takes direction well on revisions

Strong English communication skills

Comfortable starting with a lighter initial workload that grows as trust and consistency are established



Nice to Have



Experience designing for coaches, consultants, course creators, or other info-business/education-based brands specifically

Basic understanding of A/B testing thumbnails or using YouTube Studio analytics to inform design choices

Experience with other supporting design work — channel banners, social graphics, or simple ad creatives

Basic video editing skills (not required, but a plus)



To Apply

Please send:



A portfolio showing YouTube thumbnails specifically — ideally with the videos/channels they were made for, so we can see them in context

Your typical turnaround time per thumbnail/batch

Your rate (open to proposals — tell us how you'd structure it: per thumbnail, hourly, or monthly retainer). Note that we're starting with a lower volume and scaling based on quality, so flexibility on early workload is a plus



We're looking to build a long-term working relationship, not a one-off gig. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Growth & Marketing Strategy**

title: Instagram DM Appointment Setter for Marketing Agency and Business Coach (Remote, Commission-Driven)
description:
We are The Working Class Marketing, a lead generation agency for owner-operated home services companies (HVAC, plumbing, and other trades), plus a coaching business that helps home services owners grow. We are hiring a DM setter to work directly in our partner Mike's Instagram inbox.



Your one job: turn conversations into booked calls with Mike and our team. This is a sales role, not a customer service or admin role. You will be measured on qualified calls booked and how many of them show up.



What you will do every day:

- Live in Mike's Instagram DMs during your shift: reply to inbound DMs, story replies, and comments fast, in minutes, not hours

- Re-engage old leads and stale conversations that went quiet, and work a daily follow-up list until every lead reaches a clear outcome

- Start conversations with followers and people who engage with Mike's content

- Qualify prospects with short, natural questions, one at a time: what kind of business they run, where they are stuck, budget, and timing

- Book qualified prospects onto calls with Mike and the team, send the booking link, confirm the appointment, and send reminders so calls actually show

- Handle basic objections (no time, not sure, thinking about it) without getting pushy or sounding scripted

- Log and tag every conversation in our CRM (GoHighLevel) and send a short end-of-day report: conversations handled, follow-ups sent, calls booked, calls that showed



What makes a great setter here:

- Sales-minded and commission-hungry. You want your pay tied to results, not an easy hourly gig

- Fast. Warm leads go cold in minutes, so speed is a skill, not a nice-to-have

- You write like a person: short, warm messages that match the lead's tone and length. No copy-paste blasts

- You qualify properly: one clear question at a time until fit is known (need, budget, timing)

- Relentless follow-up. You check back with quiet leads on schedule and never let a conversation die from neglect

- Organized. Every lead tagged and logged in the CRM, every day, no exceptions

- Coachable and consistent. You follow our scripts and SOPs, adapt them to the person, and show up every shift

- Thick-skinned. Rejection and ghosting do not slow you down



Requirements:

- 1+ year of DM appointment setting or DM sales experience, ideally for an agency, coaching, or other high-ticket offer

- Excellent written English, near-native, with a natural conversational tone

- Able to manage many conversations at once without losing track

- Available during US Eastern Time hours, some weekend coverage to keep response times fast

- GoHighLevel experience is a plus

- Home services or trades knowledge is a plus, not required



Pay: $5 to $7 per hour depending on experience, plus commission on the deals you help close. The base gets you in the door, the commission is where the money is. If you are looking for an easy hourly paycheck with no pressure to perform, this is not the role for you.



How to apply (applications that skip these steps will not be considered):

1. Start your application with the word SETTER so we know you read this.

2. Tell us: your DM setting experience (how long, what kind of offer), how many conversations a day you have handled, and your calls-booked results if you tracked them.

3. Sample task: a home services owner replies to a story with "how much do you charge?" Write the exact DM you would send back.

4. Confirm your availability for US Eastern hours and when you can start.

title: FOIA Researcher & Crime Leads Finder (True Crime / Bodycam YouTube Channel)
description:
We run a YouTube channel that makes documentaries from police body-camera and dashcam footage released under US public records laws (FOIA and state open-records acts).



We are looking for a researcher whose main job is to find cases that involve FAMOUS or WELL-KNOWN people, and to get the footage for them.



WHO COUNTS AS "FAMOUS"

- Athletes: Olympic, NFL, NBA, MLB, UFC, college stars

- Actors, musicians, rappers, reality-TV people

- Influencers, YouTubers, streamers, TikTok creators

- Politicians, mayors, judges, police chiefs and other public officials

- Coaches, CEOs, local celebrities



WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Every day, search news sites, police press releases, jail rosters, court records and social media for new US arrests and police i
 involving well-known people.

2. Add each lead to our Google Sheet: who the person is, what happened, date, city and state, police agency, case or i
 number if known, news links, and one line on why it would make a good video.

3. Check on YouTube whether the full body-cam footage has already been published by other channels.

4. Find the correct records office for the agency and prepare and send public-records requests for body-cam, dashcam, 911 audio and reports. We give you templates and the requester details.

5. Track every request: date sent, portal or
, fees quoted, status, follow-ups, files received.

6. Download and organize the released files.



WHAT MAKES A GOOD CASE

- A famous or recognizable person

- The i
 was recorded on body cam or dashcam

- Adults only (no minors)

- Happened in the last 2 years

- The footage has NOT already been covered in full by big channels

- States with fast records laws are best (Florida, Texas, Ohio, Arizona, Washington and others)



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent written English

- Strong online research skills (Google, news archives, court and jail websites)

- Organized and accurate with spreadsheets

- Comfortable with US government records portals (GovQA, NextRequest, JustFOIA) or ready to learn fast

- Reliable, with a short daily update

- Experience with FOIA / public records, true-crime research or journalism is a big plus



TERMS

- Full time, 40 hours per week

- $500 per month

- The first week is a free trial week



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word BODYCAM so we know you read this post. Then send:

1. One arrest or police i
 from the last 12 months involving a famous person that you think has body-cam footage and has not been covered in full on YouTube, with a news link.

2. The name of the police agency you would request the footage from.

title: Senior Business Development Representative – U.S. Staffing Client Acquisition
description:
# Senior Business Development Representative – U.S. Staffing Client Acquisition



**Company:** Mirror Talent Group LLC  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Engagement:** Full-Time Independent Contractor  

**Compensation:** $500–$800 USD/month base + 10% uncapped placement commission



### About Mirror Talent Group



Mirror Talent Group LLC is a U.S.-based direct-hire recruitment firm specializing in healthcare, customer service, contact center operations, and professional recruitment.



We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Business Development professional who can independently acquire U.S. employer clients, negotiate recruitment agreements, and secure qualified job orders.



**This is a full-cycle client acquisition and closing position—not a lead generation, research, appointment-setting, or candidate sourcing role.**



### Key Responsibilities



- Independently prospect and engage U.S. employers with active recruitment needs.

- Conduct outbound sales calls, personalized
 outreach, and direct engagement with decision-makers.

- Build relationships with HR leaders, talent acquisition executives, hiring managers, and business owners.

- Identify and qualify hiring needs, budgets, urgency, and opportunities for external recruiting support.

- Lead discovery calls, present recruitment solutions, handle objections, and advance sales opportunities.

- Negotiate within approved company pricing and contractual guidelines.

- Personally secure signed client agreements and qualified, actionable job orders.

- Maintain accurate CRM records and provide consistent pipeline updates.

- Coordinate successful client handoffs to recruitment operations.



### Required Qualifications



- Proven full-cycle business development experience within the U.S. staffing or recruitment industry.

- Demonstrated success personally acquiring U.S. employer clients and securing qualified job orders.

- Strong understanding of direct-hire recruitment, agency fee structures, and client acquisition.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Comfortable coordinating prospect calls and meetings during U.S. business hours.

- Experience with CRM platforms and outbound sales tools.



**We are not seeking lead researchers, list builders, appointment setters, or candidate sourcers. We need a proven closer who can take an opportunity from initial contact to a signed agreement and qualified job order.**



### Compensation & Opportunity



- **Monthly base: $500–$800 USD**, determined by relevant experience and demonstrated sales results.

- **Commission: 10% of eligible placement fees collected by Mirror Talent Group** from qualifying client accounts.

- Uncapped commission earning potential.

- Remote independent contractor opportunity.

- Flexibility to manage your schedule while coordinating with U.S. decision-makers.

Commission eligibility, payment schedules, and account ownership terms will be outlined in the independent contractor agreement.



### Performance Expectations



We measure success by actual business acquired, not simply outreach volume.



Initial performance objectives include:



- First signed client agreement within 60 days.

- At least two signed client agreements and two qualified job orders cumulatively within 90 days.

- Consistent development and management of qualified employer opportunities.

- Accurate CRM documentation and proactive communication regarding sales progress.

### Selection Process



Shortlisted candidates will complete a live sales interview and practical business development assessment.



Finalists must provide at least two professional references, including a former supervisor or manager who can verify their direct involvement in acquiring U.S. staffing clients and generating job orders.



**If you are an experienced U.S. staffing business development closer who thrives on winning new business, we'd like to hear from you.**

title: Property Operations & Finance VA
description:
We are looking for an experienced Property Communications, Bookings & Finance Virtual Assistant to join our UK property business.



We manage serviced accommodation and HMO properties. We need someone who can take ownership of our daily communications, convert enquiries into confirmed bookings and keep our financial administration accurate and up to date.



You should communicate clearly, work confidently with numbers, prioritise effectively and follow tasks through without repeated reminders.



This is a full-time remote role, Monday to Friday, with a scheduled working window of 8am–6pm UK time, including agreed breaks. You must be available to follow UK local time throughout the year.



Your day will generally be structured around:



* 8am–9am: reviewing recent financial activity, reconciling payments, recording invoices and identifying outstanding actions.

* 9am–5pm: property communications, booking conversions, payment chasing and ongoing administration, with scheduled breaks.

* 5pm–6pm: completing financial records, preparing approval requests and providing a clear daily handover.



You will remain available for urgent guest issues during the finance sessions. Time-sensitive booking invoices and payment links should be handled promptly throughout the day.



Your responsibilities will include:



1. Property communications



* Manage messages and calls from guests, HMO tenants, prospective customers, landlords, suppliers and contractors.

* Read the full conversation and booking history before replying, addressing every question or concern raised.

* Manage enquiries, pre-arrival requirements, check-in support, extensions and checkout communication.

* Check required guest information, rental agreements, payments and security deposits before releasing access instructions.

* Handle routine tenant enquiries, rent reminders, maintenance reports and access arrangements.

* Coordinate with our cleaning and maintenance team, keep people informed and follow up until there is a confirmed outcome.

* Maintain accurate notes, outstanding tasks and handovers.

* Escalate urgent problems and matters requiring director approval.



2. Direct bookings and sales follow-up



* Understand prospective guests’ dates, requirements and budget.

* Recommend suitable properties and provide accurate quotes using approved rates and terms.

* Follow up enquiries, quotations and payment links by message,
 or telephone.

* Answer questions confidently and help interested guests complete their bookings.

* Identify extension and repeat-booking opportunities.

* Keep an enquiry tracker showing the next action, follow-up date and outcome.

* Track opportunities through to confirmed, paid bookings.



3. Finance and administration



* Record new invoices and receipts the same working day.

* Allocate income and expenses to the correct property, company and reporting period.

* Create and check booking, extension, rent and other business invoices.

* Chase unpaid balances and maintain accurate payment records.

* Match reservations, platform payouts, payment-processor transactions and bank receipts.

* Investigate discrepancies, missing payments and duplicate entries.

* Check supplier invoices against agreed charges and completed work.

* Maintain property bills, deposit, refund and expense trackers.

* Prepare property income and expense summaries and supporting information for management and investor reporting.

* Organise financial documents and prepare clear payment and approval requests for the directors.



You must work within agreed approval limits. Payments, refunds, deductions, discounts and other financial commitments must follow the permissions given to you.



We are looking for someone who:



* Has hands-on experience in guest or property communications and bookkeeping or finance administration.

* Can demonstrate experience following up enquiries and securing bookings or sales.

* Writes clear, natural English and is confident speaking on the telephone.

* Is comfortable using Google Sheets or Excel and accounting software such as QuickBooks.

* Notices inconsistencies, checks their work and asks for clarification when needed.

* Can manage several open tasks while keeping priorities and deadlines clear.

* Takes feedback professionally, corrects mistakes and applies what they have learned.

* Takes ownership, reports blockers early and follows through reliably.

* Has a reliable computer, internet connection, calling setup and backup arrangements.



Experience with Hostaway, Airbnb, 
 and UK HMO administration would be an advantage.



You will begin with a structured finance handover, shadowing our existing administrator and completing supervised tasks. Communications responsibilities will be introduced in stages as you learn our properties and demonstrate accuracy.



We will train you in our systems and procedures. You should already have the core communication, sales follow-up and finance skills required for the role.



To apply, use the subject line “Property Communications & Finance” and include:



1. Your CV and a brief explanation of your relevant experience.

2. The property, communication and accounting systems you have used.

3. An example of an enquiry you helped convert into a confirmed booking or sale.

4. An example of a financial discrepancy you identified and resolved.

5. Confirmation that you can work the stated UK schedule, your earliest start date and your expected monthly salary in USD.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short practical assessment covering communication, booking follow-up, prioritisation and financial accuracy.



We’re looking for someone we can trust to take ownership, communicate thoughtfully and grow with our business.

title: E-commerce Inventory & Listings Specialist (Amazon, Shopify)
description:
E-commerce Inventory & Listings Specialist (Amazon, Shopify)

Full-time, remote. Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm US Central (10:00pm to 7:00am Manila time from November to March; 9:00pm to 6:00am from March to November). Reports to Michelle, Operations.



IF YOU'VE EVER CAUGHT A BAD FLAT FILE BEFORE IT WENT LIVE, READ ON

The inventory file says one number, the warehouse says another, and the upload is due in the morning. Most people upload and hope. We're looking for the person who stops, traces the gap to its source, and fixes it first.



ABOUT LUX & NYX

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy's, and through a corporate gifting channel. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu.



THE ROLE

You'll own the accuracy of everything we put on a marketplace and every number we report on: available-to-sell and inventory files, listings on Amazon, Shopify and our retail partners, our daily sales and ads reports, and the orders, returns and customer messages that follow. You'll be our warehouse's main contact, and you'll work closely with Michelle, who leads operations.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Inventory and available-to-sell files: keep one master product sheet as the source, reconcile inventory and ATS files for SKU, UPC and quantity before every upload, and check them live after. That includes Amazon, Shopify, our retail portals, and our ESP and SAGE corporate gifting catalogs.

• Listings: launches, price updates, retired SKUs, flat files and approved promotions, plus a weekly check for suppressed or rejected listings.

• Reporting: prepare our daily sales report and marketing ads reports, check every number against its source, and flag what doesn't add up.

• Orders, returns and the warehouse: keep orders moving, check the returns, files and invoices our warehouse sends, and follow up with vendors until every issue is closed.

• Customer care and reviews: answer customers within one business day, warmly and in our brand voice, including refunds, returns and warranty claims.

• Production support: prepare purchase orders, packing lists and shipping documents from approved inputs for our weekly production meeting.

• Tickets and SOPs: follow every Seller Support and portal ticket until it's fixed, and write down every step you own.



Not part of this role: pricing, budget and other financial decisions, paid ads management, forecasting, corporate gifting quotes and orders (another teammate owns those), running the warehouse floor, product design, and accounting.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You stop rather than upload. If a count, price or SKU doesn't match its source, nothing goes live until it does. That's the number one thing.

• Hands-on listing work for a brand or seller: Amazon flat files, Seller Central, retailer portals or Shopify product setup, including fixing rejected or suppressed listings.

• 2+ years reconciling inventory, orders, invoices or e-commerce reports for someone else to act on.

• Strong spreadsheet skills: formulas, lookups and reconciliations.

• Comfortable with totals, per-unit costs and variances, and you can show where every figure came from.

• Customer care for an online brand, written warmly and clearly.

• You work it out yourself. AI can help you draft or double-check, but the thinking and the judgment are yours.

• Clear, polished written English, and steady follow-through without anyone having to chase you.

• Here for the long haul: you want to own this work and get great at it.



A strong plus: Mirakl, ShipStation, ESP or SAGE catalogs, EDI, packing lists and carton planning, or working day to day with a 3PL.



You don't need every box ticked. If you catch the mistake before it goes live and you can show where every number came from, we want to hear from you.



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

• Every upload matches the master sheet, and nothing goes live with an open question.

• Every report goes out on time and matches its source.

• Customers hear back within one business day.

• Every open ticket and vendor issue has a next step.



PAY AND BENEFITS

US$600 to $1,300 a month depending on experience, plus a performance bonus. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Weekly 1:1 with Michelle, async-first on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph. Your application must do three things:



1. Start with the word TRACE.

2. Answer this in your own words: It's Monday, December 21. Tomorrow at 10:00am US Central you upload the Amazon available-to-sell file. Last Friday's inventory file shows 448 units of the Belt Bag in Black. On Saturday, 30 units shipped on a corporate order. Today's warehouse count shows 412 units. 12 customer returns arrived Friday and haven't been inspected yet. The warehouse is closed Thursday and Friday for Christmas. What number would you upload, what do you check before you do, who do you tell, and by when?

3. Include your resume, or a Google Drive link to it that opens.



Applications missing any of the three won't be reviewed. Those three steps are deliberate: they show us, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and own the details.



NEXT STEPS

If you're shortlisted: a short form and a recorded video intro, then a paid skills test, then a call with our founder where you'll walk us through some of your answers. Then an offer.

title: AI Marketing Content Operator
description:
SB is hiring a sharp, self-starting content operator to turn the CEO's ideas into polished daily posts, articles, and videos, using AI tools at every step.



About the role

You work directly with Jeff, CEO of SB, a cybersecurity assessment firm founded in 2011 and headquartered in Texas. Jeff is the subject expert. You are the engine that gets his thinking published every day.

• The content is Jeff's personal brand first. Most posts go out as Jeff on his own LinkedIn, then get cross-posted to SB's channels.

• Jeff supplies the substance. Drafts reach you 80 to 90 percent complete. You add the hook, the polish, the format, the branding, and the video.

• The topics are technical and executive-level. Think cybersecurity compliance and running a business, not lifestyle content.

• The standard is high-end. SB's image is precise, upbeat, and professional. Close enough is not acceptable, and neither is anything that looks AI-generated.

• AI is your main tool. You're expected to use AI for research, drafting, editing, graphics, and video, and to apply the judgment that AI lacks.



What you do

The role has four parts, and you need to be capable in all four.

• Research and idea sourcing

    ◦ Track current events, industry news, and regulatory changes, and recommend timely topics.

    ◦ Watch what competitors, partners, and industry voices are saying, so Jeff stays current and relevant.

    ◦ Bring Jeff a short list of content ideas every day.

    ◦ Maintain a prioritized list of content ideas.

• Writing and polish

    ◦ Turn near-final drafts into finished blogs, articles, and posts for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

    ◦ Help write strong hooks and headlines, tighten wording, and fix every error.

    ◦ Adapt one idea into the right format for each platform.

• Video and graphics

    ◦ Take raw video recordings on Riverside or other tools and produce edited, captioned clips.

    ◦ Create branded graphics and thumbnails with AI tools, at a professional standard.

• Publishing and LinkedIn management

    ◦ Schedule and publish approved content every day.

    ◦ Monitor Jeff's LinkedIn feed and flag what matters.

    ◦ Find and connect with relevant people in adjacent industries.

    ◦ Over time, reply to comments and direct messages in Jeff's voice, and escalate anything you're unsure about.



What you bring

Required:

• High intelligence and fast learning. The subject matter is complex. You don't need to know Cybersecurity, Compliance, or Defense info but you need to pick up technical topics quickly.

• Technical curiosity. Cybersecurity and technology interest you. If these topics bore you, this role is not a fit.

• Extreme attention to detail. You catch the typo, the off-brand color, and the wrong date before anyone else sees them.

• Initiative. If you're unsure, you make your best attempt and bring it for feedback. You don't wait to be told what to do.

• High energy. You bring ideas, ask questions, and push the work forward.

• Careful listening. You take detailed notes, and feedback given once stays fixed.

• Excellent written English. You write and edit at a professional, near-native level.

• Good spoken English. You can speak English well enough to be understood easily.

• Daily, hands-on AI use. You use tools such as Claude and ChatGPT as part of how you work, and you can tell good output from generic output.

• Social media fluency. You know how LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube differ and what performs on each.

• Basic video and design skills. You can edit short-form video and produce clean, branded graphics.



Helpful but not required:

• Experience with Riverside, Canva, or Capcut.

• Experience ghostwriting or managing social media for an executive

• Background in technology, cybersecurity, or business-to-business marketing



How we work

• Hours: Full-time. You must be online from 7 AM to 2 PM US Central time, Monday through Friday. Most content is created and published in the morning.

• Location: Fully remote, US, Philipines, or South America. Skills matter more than location.

• Approvals: Jeff reviews and approves every piece before it publishes. After your work consistently needs no changes (expect three to six months), you earn the right to publish independently.

• Training: Jeff trains you on his voice, style, and standards. You're expected to learn them quickly and apply them without reminders.

• Success at 90 days: We publish high-quality content every day, in at least one format, without chasing anyone.



Pay and terms

• Pay: Based on skill and experience.

• Type: Contractor or employee, depending on your location.

• Trial: Finalists may be asked to complete a short paid trial project.



How to apply

Send the following. Applications that skip a step are not reviewed.

1.  Your resume or CV.

2.  A two-minute video of you explaining any technical topic of your choice to a business executive. 

3.  Two or three samples of content you produced (posts, articles, graphics, or video clips), with a note on which AI tools you used and how.

4.  A one-paragraph answer: Which executive/expert posts on LinkedIn really well, and what makes it work well?

Improve product descriptions, graphics, and website messaging.

How to Apply

Links to 2–3 Shopify websites you've personally worked on.



What you specifically did for those websites (development, apps, customization, optimization, etc.).

Your experience with Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.



Your expected hourly or monthly compensation.



Your availability during US Central Time hours.

We're looking for a long-term team member who wants to grow with our business, not just complete occasional freelance assignments.

title: Part-Time 3D Artist / Blender Generalist — Realistic Science, Anatomy & Simulation Assets
description:
Company: Kiku Learning

Location: Remote — Philippines

Schedule: Flexible, part-time or project-based, approximately 5–10 hours per week when projects are active

Compensation: $8–$15 USD/hour initially, negotiable based on portfolio and specialized experience

Engagement: As-needed projects with opportunities for ongoing collaboration



About Kiku Learning



Kiku Learning is an emerging science and healthcare education platform combining comprehensive academic lessons with interactive 3D laboratories, realistic scientific environments, and clinical learning experiences.



We are building an educational platform where students can explore scientific concepts rather than simply read about them.



Our existing projects include:



Mount Kiku: a realistic mountain expedition used to teach calculus, gradients, optimization, and scientific reasoning.



Evolution Island: an interactive ecosystem and evolution experience.



A 3D nephron simulation for renal anatomy and physiology.



An interactive human heart anatomy viewer.



Planned operating-room simulations, surgical anatomy environments, and additional science laboratories.



We already have an operational development workflow and working prototypes. We are seeking an artist to help elevate the visual realism, asset quality, and animation of these experiences.



Responsibilities



3D Modeling and Environment Design



Create realistic 3D models, environments, props, and scientific visualizations.



Develop detailed mountains, rocks, snow, ice, terrain, and expedition equipment.



Create realistic operating-room environments, hospital equipment, surgical instruments, and medical props.



Build or adapt anatomical models using provided scientific references.



Produce realistic materials, textures, lighting setups, and environmental details.



Rigging and Animation



Rig and animate characters, wildlife, and interactive objects.



Develop natural movement and realistic animation sequences.



Prepare assets for use in interactive simulations.



Collaborate with our developer on animation and model integration.



Technical Asset Preparation



Work primarily in Blender or comparable professional 3D software.



Export models in GLB/glTF and other suitable formats.



Optimize polygon counts, texture sizes, UV maps, and materials for browser performance.



Create PBR textures and organized model hierarchies.



Prepare clean, editable source files and document asset specifications.



Modify licensed third-party assets when their terms permit it.



Scientific and Educational Quality



Follow supplied anatomical, scientific, and technical references.



Identify when an anatomical or scientific detail requires expert verification.



Avoid inventing anatomical structures or presenting visually attractive but inaccurate models as scientifically validated.



Work collaboratively with developers and subject-matter reviewers.



Required Qualifications



Strong portfolio of professional 3D modeling work.



Proficiency in Blender.



Experience with realistic texturing, UV mapping, lighting, and PBR materials.



Experience optimizing 3D models for real-time applications.



Ability to export and troubleshoot GLB/glTF assets.



Strong communication and ability to follow visual references.



Willingness to work on existing projects rather than requiring a complete redesign.



Highly Preferred Qualifications



Experience with medical or anatomical visualization.



Experience with realistic terrain and environment creation.



Character rigging and animation.



Experience with Three.js or WebGL asset workflows.



Experience with procedural modeling, photogrammetry, sculpting, or ZBrush.



Experience with interactive simulations, game development, or educational applications.



Experience in every category is not required. Please clearly identify your strongest specialties.



What Success Looks Like



We want 3D experiences that feel professional, realistic, and immersive without sacrificing educational accuracy or website performance.



For medical anatomy, visual accuracy must be evaluated against credible references and approved by appropriate subject-matter reviewers before educational publication.



We value originality, attention to detail, technical discipline, and a collaborative approach.



How to Apply



Please provide:



Your portfolio, ArtStation, Sketchfab, or comparable work samples.



Examples of realistic environments, anatomical models, rigged characters, or interactive assets.



Your experience preparing models for browser-based applications.



Your hourly rate and availability.



Your preferred 3D software and export formats.



Whether you have previously worked on scientific, medical, or educational visualizations.



Application question: How would you create a realistic, browser-optimized human heart or snowy mountain environment for an interactive science education platform, and what would you do to ensure the final model is accurate and performs well?



Shortlisted applicants may be offered a small, paid practical assignment.



We are excited to collaborate with artists who enjoy combining technical skill, creativity, and education.

### Long-Term Growth & Career Opportunities



Kiku Learning is an early-stage educational technology company with ambitious plans for growth. Our vision extends beyond creating a traditional learning website. We are developing a comprehensive, interactive science and healthcare education platform designed to serve students across multiple disciplines and potentially around the world.



Although this position will begin as part-time, flexible, and project-based, **we are looking for individuals who may be interested in growing with the company long-term.**



As Kiku Learning develops, expands its curriculum, launches additional interactive laboratories, and grows its subscriber base, there may be opportunities for:



- Transitioning into a full-time position with a more structured schedule and established compensation.

- Increased hourly compensation based on responsibilities, performance, company growth, and available funding.

- Advancement into senior, lead, or management roles as the technical and creative teams expand.

- Taking ownership of larger projects, new learning experiences, and future platform developments.

- Becoming a long-term member of Kiku Learning's core development team.



We value creativity, initiative, technical excellence, collaboration, and a genuine commitment to making science education more accessible and engaging.



Our goal is to build a team where talented individuals have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully, develop professionally, and grow alongside the company.



**Please note:** Future full-time employment, promotions, and compensation increases are potential opportunities rather than guaranteed commitments. They will depend on business performance, funding, individual contributions, and organizational needs.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
Accounts Payable Specialist



Position Details

• Position: Accounts Payable Specialist

• Location: Remote

• Schedule: Full-time, aligned with U.S. Pacific Time business hours

• Reports To: Accounts Payable Director



Position Overview

The Accounts Payable Specialist manages end-to-end invoice processing and payments for a multi-entity healthcare organization, handling AP activity for at least 15 entities and their locations. Working closely with the Accounts Payable Director, this role ensures every invoice is accurately reviewed, coded to the correct entity and location, and paid on time in line with its due date. It is ideal for a detail-oriented AP professional who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and resolves issues proactively.



Candidate Expectations

• Ability to manage invoice processing for at least 15 entities.

• Detailed review of invoices prior to entry, ensuring the appropriate entity and location are assigned.

• Timely and accurate payment of invoices in line with their due dates.

• Solid understanding of core AP responsibilities.

• Clear communication skills.

• Strong problem-solving abilities.

• Initiative to resolve issues immediately.



Key Responsibilities

• Manage daily invoice processing for at least 15 entities and their locations.

• Review each invoice in detail before entry, confirming the correct entity, location, coding, approvals, and supporting documentation.

• Process payments accurately and on time based on invoice due dates, including preparing and supporting weekly check runs.

• Monitor open invoices and follow up promptly on missing approvals, documentation, or discrepancies.

• Identify and resolve invoice and payment issues immediately, escalating to the AP Director when needed.

• Respond to vendor inquiries professionally and maintain accurate vendor records.

• Collaborate with facility staff, controllers, and the treasury team to resolve discrepancies and keep payments aligned with funding schedules.

• Assist with month-end close activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and reporting support.

• Prepare documentation and assist with internal and external audit requests.

• Support process improvements, documentation, and internal controls within the AP function.

• Handle additional ad hoc assignments as business needs dictate.



Qualifications

• 2–4 years of Accounts Payable experience.

• Solid understanding of core AP responsibilities, workflows, and internal controls.

• Experience managing AP across multiple entities or locations required; experience with 15 or more entities strongly preferred.

• Experience in senior living, healthcare, or real estate preferred.

• Experience with AP or spend management systems (e.g., Ramp, 
, Sage, NetSuite, Tipalti, Coupa, AvidXchange, or Stampli).

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting systems.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management skills.

• Reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace for remote work.



Key Qualities

• Accuracy: Reviews every invoice carefully to ensure the correct entity, location, and coding before entry.

• Timeliness: Pays invoices in line with their due dates and keeps check runs on schedule.

• Clear Communication: Communicates questions, updates, and issues clearly with the AP Director, team members, facilities, and vendors.

• Problem Solving: Investigates discrepancies and identifies practical solutions.

• Initiative: Takes ownership of issues and resolves them immediately rather than waiting for direction.



Work Environment

This is a fully remote role in a fast-paced, multi-entity healthcare accounting environment with multiple priorities and deadlines. The position works closely with the Accounts Payable Director and collaborates with treasury, accounting, and facility teams across the organization, with opportunities for growth within the accounting and finance function.

* Is comfortable having difficult conversations and holding business partners accountable.

title: Part-Time Three.js / Full-Stack Web Developer — Interactive Science Education Platform
description:
Company: Kiku Learning

Location: Remote — Philippines

Schedule: Part-time, flexible, approximately 6–12 hours per week initially

Compensation: $10–$18 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated experience

Engagement: Ongoing, as-needed project work with potential for increased hours



About Kiku Learning



Kiku Learning is a developing online science and healthcare education platform designed to make challenging subjects easier to understand through interactive learning, realistic 3D laboratories, clinical scenarios, visual explanations, and meaningful connections between scientific concepts.



Our goal is to create an academically rigorous but engaging learning experience for students pursuing nursing, medicine, allied health, and other science-related fields.



The platform is already under active development. We are not starting from scratch.



We currently have an established website with course content, learning units, interactive educational features, and several working 3D laboratory prototypes. Our existing work includes:



Mount Kiku, an interactive 3D mountain expedition that connects calculus, slopes, derivatives, elevation, weather, and optimization.



Evolution Island, an ecosystem and evolutionary biology simulation.



A 3D nephron learning experience.



An interactive human heart anatomy viewer with external and cross-sectional models.



Additional anatomy, pharmacology, clinical education, and student learning tools.



Our development workflow currently uses AI-assisted coding, GitHub, Cloudflare, and Three.js.



We are seeking a skilled developer who can take ownership of the technical implementation, improve the quality of existing features, and help us expand our interactive learning experiences.



Responsibilities



Review and understand our existing codebase and website architecture.



Improve and maintain existing functionality without unnecessary redesigns.



Integrate professional 3D models, animations, and interactive environments into the website.



Work with Three.js, WebGL, GLB/glTF files, textures, lighting, and shaders.



Improve realistic movement, camera controls, navigation, and student interaction in 3D labs.



Optimize website and 3D performance for desktop, tablets, and mobile devices.



Troubleshoot technical issues and implement well-tested fixes.



Collaborate with a 3D artist to integrate custom assets.



Maintain clean, documented code and safe GitHub development workflows.



Test changes in staging before production deployment.



Help translate educational concepts into engaging, functional simulations.



Required Qualifications



Demonstrable experience with JavaScript and modern web development.



Experience with Three.js, React Three Fiber, Babylon.js, or comparable browser-based 3D technology; direct Three.js experience strongly preferred.



Ability to work with GitHub and existing codebases.



Understanding of 3D model loading, optimization, lighting, and rendering.



Experience with responsive websites and performance optimization.



Strong problem-solving ability and clear English communication.



Ability to work independently and explain technical decisions to a nontechnical founder.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with Blender and 3D asset pipelines.



Experience with Cloudflare deployment.



Experience creating interactive educational tools, simulations, games, or scientific visualizations.



Familiarity with physics-based interactions, mathematical visualization, or animation.



Experience collaborating with AI-assisted development workflows.



What We're Looking For



We want someone who is creative, technically capable, reliable, and genuinely interested in building meaningful educational technology.



You do not need to be a medical professional or a science educator. Scientific content and anatomy will undergo separate subject-matter review.



We value thoughtful solutions, honest communication, and preserving the work that is already functioning.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your resume and portfolio or GitHub profile.



Links to two or three interactive websites, 3D applications, or simulations you personally developed.



A brief explanation of your experience with Three.js or similar technology.



Your hourly rate and weekly availability.



Your experience with existing codebases and AI-assisted development tools.



Application question: How would you improve the visual realism and free movement of an existing Three.js mountain simulation without breaking its current mathematics and learning features?



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small, paid technical assessment.



We look forward to meeting developers who want to help build the next generation of interactive science education.

Long-Term Growth & Career Opportunities



Kiku Learning is an early-stage educational technology company with ambitious plans for growth. Our vision extends beyond creating a traditional learning website. We are developing a comprehensive, interactive science and healthcare education platform designed to serve students across multiple disciplines and potentially around the world.



Although this position will begin as part-time, flexible, and project-based, we are looking for individuals who may be interested in growing with the company long-term.



As Kiku Learning develops, expands its curriculum, launches additional interactive laboratories, and grows its subscriber base, there may be opportunities for:



Transitioning into a full-time position with a more structured schedule and established compensation.



Increased hourly compensation based on responsibilities, performance, company growth, and available funding.



Advancement into senior, lead, or management roles as the technical and creative teams expand.



Taking ownership of larger projects, new learning experiences, and future platform developments.



Becoming a long-term member of Kiku Learning's core development team.



We value creativity, initiative, technical excellence, collaboration, and a genuine commitment to making science education more accessible and engaging.



Our goal is to build a team where talented individuals have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully, develop professionally, and grow alongside the company.



Please note: Future full-time employment, promotions, and compensation increases are potential opportunities rather than guaranteed commitments. They will depend on business performance, funding, individual contributions, and organizational needs.

title: Appointment Setter/Outbound Calling Specialist
description:
Five Star Bath Solutions of Sioux Falls



Remote  |  $5.00 USD/hour + performance bonuses  |  40 hours/week  |  Monday–Friday, 12–8 PM U.S. Central  |  Initial 60-day paid pilot



About Our Company

Five Star Bath Solutions of Sioux Falls is a growing bathroom remodeling company serving homeowners throughout South Dakota, Nebraska, Iowa, and Minnesota. We specialize in walk-in showers, tub-to-shower conversions, and bathtub replacements.



About the Position

 

This is a phone-intensive sales support position—not a general virtual assistant role. We generate approximately 300 new leads per month. Your job is to respond quickly, connect with homeowners, qualify their needs, and schedule appointments. Speed-to-lead is a top priority. Expect approximately 100–200 outbound call attempts daily depending on lead volume and campaign activity.



Primary Responsibilities

• Respond promptly to new leads during working hours, prioritizing speed-to-lead

• Make approximately 100–200 outbound call attempts per day

• Qualify interested homeowners and schedule in-home sales appointments

• Follow up with unresponsive leads, event prospects, and older inquiries

• Confirm appointments and help reduce cancellations and no-shows

• Accurately record call outcomes and customer details in the CRM

• Coordinate appointment information with the sales team

• Track daily activity, contacts, qualified appointments, and appointment attendance

• Follow company procedures and honor opt-out requests



English Communication Requirements:

Exceptional spoken English is essential. Our customers are primarily Midwestern U.S. homeowners. You must speak fluent, easily understood conversational English; listen carefully; build rapport naturally; handle objections without relying entirely on a script; and communicate comfortably with older American homeowners. Prior outbound calling experience with U.S. customers is strongly preferred.



Required Qualifications:

• Proven outbound calling, appointment-setting, telemarketing, or inside-sales experience

• Experience speaking with U.S.-based customers

• Comfortable with high call volume and frequent unanswered calls

• Strong objection-handling, organization, and follow-up skills

• Reliable internet, computer, quality headset, and quiet workspace

• Ability to work Monday–Friday, 12–8 PM U.S. Central, adjusting for daylight saving time

• Familiarity with CRM and calling software; home-services experience is a plus



Compensation and 60-Day Pilot

Pay is $5.00 USD per hour for 40 hours per week, plus performance-based bonus opportunities. Bonus criteria will be discussed during interviews. This is an initial 60-day paid pilot intended to lead to an ongoing full-time role if performance and fit are strong. We will assess reliability, spoken communication, speed-to-lead, call productivity, qualified appointments, appointment attendance, CRM accuracy, and professionalism.



To Apply

1. Describe your outbound calling experience with U.S. customers and what you called about.

2. How many outbound calls did you make per day in your most recent role?

3. What were your typical appointment-setting results? Provide numbers if possible.

4. Can you consistently work Monday–Friday, 12–8 PM U.S. Central?

5. How would you respond to a homeowner who does not remember requesting remodeling information?

6. Required: Submit a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself, describing your experience, and explaining why you are a good fit.

7.     Describe your home office arrangement as well as your technology and internet speed.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates will complete a live interview and simulated customer call.
